bills.summary: Requires portable electronic devices distributed after January 1, 2026 to automatically disable their texting and computer functions when the holder is operating a motor vehicle over 10 miles an hour; eliminates the exemption from provisions, relating to the use of portable electronic devices in motor vehicles, granted to commercial motor vehicles, police, firefighters and emergency vehicle operators.

bills.title: Provides for a personal income tax deduction for school supplies paid for out-of-pocket by K-12 teachers in public and nonpublic schools, up to $500 per year
bills.summary: Provides for a personal income tax deduction for school supplies paid for out-of-pocket by K-12 teachers in public and nonpublic schools, up to $500 per year.

bills.summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to develop guidelines for transportation of students on field trips.

bills.summary: Relates to penalties for intent to cause injury to an animal.

bills.summary: Defines a real estate team as two or more persons associated with the same real estate brokerage who hold themselves out or operate as a team.

bills.summary: Directs the department of health to assign at least 1 narcotics investigator to each county in a city having a population of one million or more.

bills.summary: Relates to electronic citation fees or the process of transmitting traffic, misdemeanor, municipal ordinance, conservation, or other citations and law enforcement data via electronic means to a county clerk.

bills.summary: Relates to price gouging; defines unconscionably excessive price for the purposes of prohibiting price gouging during abnormal disruption of the market.

bills.title: Relates to sanctions for driving while ability impaired while holding a conditional license
bills.summary: Relates to sanctions for driving while ability impaired while holding a conditional license.

bills.title: Requires investigation of school district personnel involved with the care, custody or supervision of a child
bills.summary: Requires pre-employment investigation of school district personnel to determine criminal history or the presence of controlled substances or communicable diseases; requires submission to fingerprinting and other tests.

bills.title: Requires utilities to charge not-for-profit organized sports programs for youth residential rates
bills.summary: Requires gas and electric corporations to charge not-for-profit organized sports programs for youth residential rates for utilities.

bills.title: Relates to the penalty for unlawfully fleeing a uniformed police officer of the New York city taxi and limousine commission
bills.summary: Relates to the penalty for unlawfully fleeing a uniformed officer of the New York city taxi and limousine commission.

bills.summary: Exempts institutions of higher education from the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax.

bills.summary: Provides that certain sex offenders who are released on parole may not enter public, association or free libraries.

bills.title: Requires applicants for the renewal of a driver's license to prove they have acceptable vision to operate a motor vehicle
bills.summary: Requires applicants for the renewal of a driver's license to prove they have acceptable vision to operate a motor vehicle.

bills.title: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have surveillance cameras in the common areas of their residential facilities
bills.summary: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have surveillance cameras in the common areas of their residential facilities.

bills.title: Expands the definition of aggravated cruelty to animals
bills.summary: Expands the definition of aggravated cruelty to animals to include serious physical injuries or the use of a weapon.

bills.title: Relates to creating the multi-disciplinary team demonstration program for complex cases of adult abuse, neglect, or financial exploitation
bills.summary: Relates to creating the multi-disciplinary team demonstration program for complex cases of adult abuse, neglect, or financial exploitation.

bills.title: Elevates promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child and promoting a sexual performance by a child to be class B felonies
bills.summary: Elevates promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child and promoting a sexual performance by a child to be class B felonies; prohibits pleading to a lesser offense after indictment for either such offense.

bills.title: Makes the inability to pay child support an affirmative defense to non-support of child offenses, rather than an element of such offenses
bills.summary: Makes the inability to pay child support an affirmative defense to non-support of child offenses, rather than an element of such offenses.

bills.title: Establishes the class E felony of official interference with transportation
bills.summary: Establishes the class E felony of official interference with transportation.

bills.title: Relates to visitation and custody rights involving non-U.S. citizens
bills.summary: Prohibits a court from providing for visitation or custody of a minor who is a U.S. citizen to a person who resides outside the U.S. when the other party to such action is a U.S. citizen and objects to such an order.

bills.title: Relates to teen dating violence education programs
bills.summary: Relates to teen dating violence education programs; requires school districts to create policies, procedures and guidelines to implement education programs for students in kindergarten through twelfth grade to prevent, deter and address incidents of teen dating violence; defines teen dating violence.

bills.title: Creates the crimes of dangerous driving in the fifth, fourth, third, second and first degrees
bills.summary: Creates the crimes of dangerous driving in the fifth, fourth, third, second and first degrees; imposes criminal liability on drivers who continue to operate motor vehicles in violation of the vehicle and traffic law and cause injury as a result.

bills.title: Provides for sentence of life without parole for defendants convicted of certain sex offenses against a child or mentally disabled person; repealer
bills.summary: Provides for the imposition of a sentence of life imprisonment without parole for defendants convicted of certain sex offenses against a child or mentally disabled person.

bills.title: Establishes limitations upon real property tax levies in N.Y. city
bills.summary: Limits, in cities having a population of one million or more, the annual increase in real property taxes.

bills.title: Provides for random testing for anabolic steroids in athletes in public and private schools; appropriation
bills.summary: Provides for random testing for anabolic steroids in athletes in public and private schools; appropriates $1,000,000 therefor.

bills.title: Provides for penalties for causing the death of an animal
bills.summary: Provides for penalties for causing the death of an animal; makes it a class D felony.

bills.title: Imposes strict liability on manufacturers, owners, and operators of unmanned motor vehicles
bills.summary: Imposes strict liability on manufacturers, owners, and operators of unmanned motor vehicles.

bills.title: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and findings thereon
bills.summary: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and the arbitrator's findings of fact and conclusions of law.

bills.title: Relates to the registration and regulation of animal breeders
bills.summary: Relates to the registration and regulation of animal breeders; requires each to be licensed; creates a breeder licensing fund; exempts not-for-profit organizations.

bills.title: Provides that a charitable bail organization may only post bail for a person who can prove that he or she is indigent
bills.summary: Provides that a charitable bail organization may only post bail for a person who can prove that he or she is indigent.

bills.title: Provides that rape in the first degree shall be a class A-I felony
bills.summary: Provides that rape in the first degree shall be a class A-I felony and shall be punishable by life imprisonment without parole.

bills.title: Establishes the class D felony of criminal street gang recruitment on school grounds
bills.summary: Establishes the class D felony of criminal street gang recruitment on school grounds which occurs when an individual on school grounds coerces, solicits, recruits or induces another person to join or remain a member of a criminal street gang, or conspires to do so.

bills.title: Relates to authorizing uniformed court officers and court clerks designated as peace officers to execute arrest warrants
bills.summary: Relates to authorizing uniformed court officers and court clerks designated as peace officers to execute arrest warrants.

bills.title: Authorizes localities to waive citizenship requirements for certain police and firefighters in their jurisdictions
bills.summary: Authorizes localities to waive citizenship requirements for certain police and firefighters in their jurisdictions.

bills.summary: Prohibits the use of automated purchasing software to buy large quantities of goods for the purpose of retail resale of such goods.

bills.title: Enhances penalties for committing multiple animal cruelty offenses
bills.summary: Enhances penalties for committing multiple animal cruelty offenses.

bills.title: Directs the division of criminal justice services to annually provide a list of all level 2 and 3 sex offenders residing in a county, to the residents of such county
bills.summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to annually provide a list of all level 2 and 3 sex offenders residing in a county, to the residents of such county.

bills.summary: Expands the class A misdemeanor of public lewdness in the first degree to include the commission of public lewdness after having been convicted of a public lewdness offense in the previous 3 years.

bills.title: Establishes an offense for fraud relating to voter registration forms
bills.summary: Establishes fraud relating to voter registration forms as a class B misdemeanor; prohibits individuals and organizations from distributing applications for voter registration forms with marked or checked party affiliation boxes.

bills.title: Limits the provision of charitable bail to misdemeanor defendants who are first time offenders
bills.summary: Limits the provision of charitable bail to misdemeanor defendants who are first time offenders.

bills.title: Provides for a 75-25 percent split in the New York city transit authority's operating surplus between the authority and the Metropolitan transportation authority
bills.summary: Provides for a 75-25 percent split in the New York city transit authority's operating surplus between the authority and the Metropolitan transit authority where previously the split was 50-50.

bills.title: Prohibits the parking of a vehicle greater than sixty inches in height within fifteen feet of an intersection
bills.summary: Prohibits the parking of a vehicle greater than sixty inches in height within fifteen feet of an intersection.

bills.title: Provides that conviction of assault on a social worker which prevents him or her from performing a lawful duty is a felony
bills.summary: Provides that conviction of assault on a social worker which prevents him or her from performing a lawful duty is a felony.

bills.title: Enacts the child custody reform act
bills.summary: Enacts the child custody reform act to provide uniform statewide standards for the litigation and mediation of child custody disputes; provides for an initial planning conference between the judge and all parties to attempt a settlement; provides for mediation unless the court finds mediation is inappropriate; requires the chief administrator of the courts to establish plans for the conduct of administration of the mediation and preparation of evaluation reports.

bills.title: Increases the amount of money a public retirement system retiree may earn in a position of public service to $50,000
bills.summary: Increases the amount of money a public retirement system retiree may earn in a position of public service in the year 2024 and thereafter to $50,000.

bills.summary: Requires the commissioner of health to establish and publish a list of generic drug products.

bills.title: Authorizes cities to request that railroad corporations perform railroad crossing, bridge and right of ways maintenance
bills.summary: Authorizes cities to request that railroad corporations perform railroad crossing, bridge and right of ways maintenance and to perform such maintenance if the corporation fails to do so.

bills.title: Requires employees of gaming facilities to undergo human-trafficking recognition training
bills.summary: Requires employees of gaming facilities to undergo human-trafficking recognition training which shall address the nature of human trafficking, how human trafficking is defined in law, how to identify victims of human trafficking, relief and recovery options for survivors, and social and legal services available to victims.

bills.title: Creates a homeowners' bill of rights to inform consumers with regard to insuring against catastrophic loss
bills.summary: Creates a homeowners' bill of rights; directs the superintendent of financial services to issue a consumer guide on insuring against catastrophic losses.

bills.title: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a yellow dot program under which vehicle occupants' medical information is available in the glove compartment
bills.summary: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a yellow dot program under which the medical and emergency contact information of the occupants, aged 55 or older, of a motor vehicle is available to emergency personnel in the glove compartment.

bills.title: Establishes the crime of feticide
bills.summary: Establishes the crime of feticide or the intentional killing of an unborn child at any stage of gestation; makes such crime a class A felony.

bills.title: Changes the official name of the Staten Island Expressway to the POW-MIA Memorial Highway
bills.summary: Changes the official name of the Staten Island Expressway to the "POW-MIA Memorial Highway".

REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

bills.summary: Provides for family members of a crime victim and interested parties to make statements to members of the parole board; provides that such oral statement shall be made to the members of the state board of parole who will determine whether the defendant is released.

bills.title: Transfers certain lands to city of New York to be used as parklands
bills.summary: Transfers certain lands to the city of New York to be used as parklands.

bills.summary: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to contract with a certified public accounting firm for the conducting of an independent forensic audit of such authority.

bills.summary: Prohibits the diminution of health insurance benefits of public employee retirees and their dependents or reducing the employer's contributions for such insurance; defines employers to include the state, municipalities, school districts, and public authorities and commissions.

bills.summary: Establishes September fourth as "Mother Teresa Remembrance Day".

bills.summary: Relates to eligibility requirements to run for the office of president of the United States; requires upon declaration of intention to run for the office of president of the United States, an individual who is currently holding office at the state or local level must thereafter resign such state or local office.

bills.title: Requires a criminal history report for certain employment or volunteer applicants to the office for people with developmental disabilities
bills.summary: Directs the commissioner of the office for people with developmental disabilities to deny employment or volunteer applications based on a criminal history report for such applicant.

bills.title: Relates to the exclusion of uncollectible taxes from the limitation on real estate taxes in New York city
bills.summary: Relates to the exclusion of uncollectible taxes from the limitation on real estate taxes in New York City.

bills.summary: Provides for the financing of emergency room facilities in two hospitals in each borough by the New York city health and hospitals corporation; requires representation on the board from each borough.

bills.summary: Enhances the penalties for crimes committed during a riot.

bills.summary: Relates to waiving all additional fees associated with the issuance of an enhanced driver's license if such license is required within thirty days of the issuance or reissuance of a standard driver's license.

bills.title: Modifies the membership of the metropolitan transportation authority
bills.summary: Increases the membership of the metropolitan transportation authority from sixteen to seventeen members; provides for the appointment for one member from each of New York City's boroughs on the written recommendation of the mayor of New York City.

bills.title: Relates to increasing fines for certain telemarketing violations
bills.summary: Relates to establishing a fine of $25,000 for knowingly transmitting misleading, inaccurate, or false caller identification information including but not limited to providing copied or incorrect telephone numbers; raises the maximum fine for other related violations.

bills.title: Exempts mortgages of residential real property from taxation when property is purchased by owners receiving state or federal buyout of prior residence destroyed in hurricane Sandy
bills.summary: Exempts mortgages of residential real property from taxation when property is purchased by owners receiving state or federal buyout of their prior residence destroyed in hurricane Sandy.

bills.summary: Enacts Michelle and Jordan's law relating to the penalties for a second conviction of participating in an unlawful speed contest or race.

bills.summary: Relates to establishing a crisis intervention demonstration program.

bills.summary: Relates to establishing distinctive "Alzheimer's Awareness" license plates; provides that the funding for such be deposited in the "Alzheimer's disease assistance fund".

bills.summary: Creates the teen driver safety commission consisting of 12 members; requires the commission to study, examine and review the issue of teen driver safety; requires the commission to report its findings, conclusions and recommendations.

bills.title: Permits prescription refills to be filled fifteen days prior to their refill date during a state disaster emergency
bills.summary: Permits prescription refills to be filled fifteen days prior to their refill date upon the declaration of a state disaster emergency; excludes controlled substances.

bills.title: Elevates all computer tampering offenses by one degree in severity
bills.summary: Elevates all computer tampering offenses by one degree in severity.

bills.title: Defines the terms "impaired" and "intoxication" for the purposes of the vehicle and traffic law
bills.summary: Defines the terms "impaired" and "intoxication" for the purposes of the vehicle and traffic law.

bills.summary: Directs the board of standards and appeals and the city planning commission in the city of New York to mail a copy of each application for and appeal of a variance to the city council member, borough president and state legislators for the affected land.

bills.summary: Promotes understanding, awareness and enforcement of animal crime laws.

bills.title: Establishes the class E felony of dissemination of false missing child information
bills.summary: Establishes the class E felony of dissemination of false missing child information.

bills.summary: Requires certain public and nonpublic schools to provide transportation or reimburse costs incurred for such transportation for certain students residing in an area containing at least three hundred students within a one-mile radius.

bills.title: Creates the crime of falsely accusing someone of a crime
bills.summary: Creates the crime of falsely accusing someone of a crime.

bills.title: Expands eligibility for the disabled homeowners' exemption to certain surviving spouses
bills.summary: Expands eligibility for the disabled homeowners' exemption to certain surviving spouses; provides that if a person is eligible for the exemption and predeceases his or her spouse, such surviving spouse shall be eligible for the exemption, provided, that all other requirements are satisfied.

bills.title: Clarifies extension of uniform land use review procedures to not-for-profit entities
bills.summary: Clarifies the extension of uniform land use review procedures to any not-for-profit organization or corporation proposing to provide shelters to the homeless irrespective of any declaration of an emergency or a finding of need for immediate action.

bills.title: Authorizes a parking permit system for park-and-rides in the borough of Staten Island in the city of New York
bills.summary: Authorizes a parking permit system for park-and-rides in the borough of Staten Island in the city of New York; requires residents of Staten Island to receive a permit free of charge and out-of-state residents to pay an annual fee for such permit.

bills.title: Requires a mental health medical professional to examine incarcerated individuals in solitary confinement
bills.summary: Requires a mental health medical professional to examine incarcerated individuals in solitary confinement when such incarcerated individual is in such confinement for a period in excess of twenty-four hours.

bills.summary: Establishes a temporary blue ribbon commission to study bail and the bail industry; requires an interim report be issued one year after the effective date of this act including the commission's findings, conclusions and recommendations, and a final report of the same shall be issued two years after the effective date of this act including legislative proposals as it deems necessary to implement such recommendations.

bills.summary: Enacts "Cesar's law" to require the retaking of parolees who abscond from the supervision of the state board of parole.

bills.summary: Provides for revocation of probation where a person is convicted of a felony or an offense in another jurisdiction which if committed in this state would constitute a felony, while the defendant is under probation supervision for a felony offense.

bills.title: Establishes distinctive "POW-MIA" license plates and establishes the "POW-MIA awareness fund"
bills.summary: Establishes distinctive "POW-MIA" license plates; establishes the "POW-MIA awareness fund" to fund POW-MIA public education and awareness campaigns and veteran services by Rolling Thunder New York chapters and upon approval by the state director of veterans' services.

bills.title: Prohibits the siting and construction of battery energy storage systems and related facilities, systems, infrastructure, and substations of any scale and possessing any storage capacity on Staten Island
bills.summary: Prohibits the siting and construction of battery energy storage systems and related facilities, systems, infrastructure, and substations of any scale and possessing any storage capacity on Staten Island.

bills.title: Congratulating Anthony Aquaro upon the occasion of his 102nd Birthday
Expands aggravated cruelty to animals to include all animals
bills.summary: Expands aggravated cruelty to animals to include all animals.

bills.title: Amends the general business law, insurance law, and public health law regarding preneed insurance premiums
bills.summary: Relates to preneed insurance premiums.

bills.title: Relates to expanding the eligibility period for indigent legal service attorneys
bills.summary: Expands the eligibility period for indigent legal service attorneys to receive certain loan forgiveness.

bills.title: Provides an exemption for lifeguard services
bills.summary: Provides an exemption from sales and compensating use taxes for lifeguard services provided by a qualified lifeguard or aquatic supervisory staff.

bills.title: Provides that the fines for traffic infractions and traffic misdemeanors committed in a school traffic control zone are doubled
bills.summary: Provides that the fines for traffic infractions and traffic misdemeanors committed in a school traffic control zone are doubled; requires such zones to be marked by a traffic light or stop sign.

bills.title: Relates to real property tax exemptions for disabled veterans
bills.summary: Increases, at local option, real property tax exemptions for combat veterans who are 100% permanently disabled.

REFERRED TO VETERANS, HOMELAND SECURITY AND MILITARY AFFAIRS

bills.title: Relates to arson in the first degree
bills.summary: Establishes a person is guilty of arson in the first degree when he intentionally damages a building or motor vehicle by causing an explosion or a fire and when such explosion or fire is accelerated by use of ignitable liquid or flammable gas.

bills.title: Relates to collective employment negotiations, notice of the issuance of debt and capital plans and projects of the port authority of New York and New Jersey
bills.summary: Relates to collective employment negotiations, notice of the issuance of debt and capital plans and projects of the port authority of New York and New Jersey.

items.text: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS

bills.title: Prohibits monitoring of gas and electric meters any more frequently than on a monthly or billing cycle basis
bills.summary: Prohibits the monitoring, collection, recording or storing of data from gas and electric meters any more frequently than on a monthly or billing cycle basis, unless the express written consent of the consumer has been provided; requires the consent of the property owner for entry upon residential property.

bills.title: Relates to certain contracts regarding bus drivers and bus drivers' assistants
bills.summary: Relates to certain contracts regarding bus drivers and bus drivers' assistants.

bills.title: Requires a public hearing prior to procurements valued over one hundred thousand dollars are made overseas by public authorities
bills.summary: Requires a public hearing before procurements valued over one hundred thousand dollars are made overseas by public authorities.

items.text: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS

bills.title: Requires heart examinations for public school students
bills.summary: Requires heart examinations for public school students and a statement on whether the student is fit to participate in physical education or other athletic activities.

bills.title: Prohibits municipalities from transferring primary investigating authority of vehicle collisions that result in serious injury or death to a non-law enforcement agency
bills.summary: Prohibits municipalities from transferring primary investigating authority of vehicle collisions that result in serious injury or death from the police to a non-law enforcement agency.

bills.title: Includes the Sandy Ground community in the education curriculum
bills.summary: Includes the Sandy Ground community, the oldest continuously inhabited free black settlement in the United States, in the education curriculum.

bills.title: Provides for the continuation of express bus service to the south shore of Staten Island
bills.summary: Provides for the continuation of express bus service to the south shore of Staten Island.

items.text: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS

bills.title: Establishes the offenses of phishing in the third degree, phishing in the second degree and phishing in the first degree; and relates to the time in which a prosecution of such offenses must be commenced
bills.summary: Establishes the offenses of phishing in the third degree, phishing in the second degree and phishing in the first degree; relates to the time in which prosecution of such offenses must be commenced.

bills.title: Relates to the procedure followed by the justice center when responding to certain reportable incidents
bills.summary: Requires the justice center to establish procedures for when to report incidents which include suspicious and unexplained injuries including broken bones, hematomas, open wounds beyond minor first aid, black eyes, swollen noses, extreme and questionable bruising, choke marks, burns, individuals found unresponsive and all deaths to a 9-1-1 operator.

bills.title: Relates to increasing loan forgiveness for attorneys performing legal services for indigent clients
bills.summary: Increases loan reimbursement for certain attorneys who work in legal services with indigent clients from $3,400 to $5,500.

bills.title: Authorizes emergency medical care personnel to provide basic first aid to dogs and cats
bills.summary: Authorizes emergency medical care personnel to provide basic first aid to dogs and cats.

bills.title: Relates to expediting actions involving insurance claims for damages resulting from a state disaster emergency
bills.summary: Expedites actions involving insurance claims for damages resulting from a state disaster emergency; sets time frames.

bills.title: Authorizes the removal from a teacher's classroom of a violent pupil
bills.summary: Authorizes the removal from a teacher's classroom of a violent pupil; establishes that such pupil shall only return to the classroom with the consent of the teacher if the pupil committed an act of violence against a teacher.

bills.title: Redesignates certain sex, prostitution, obscenity and sexual performance offenses committed against a child as class A-I felonies with a sentence of life imprisonment without parole
bills.summary: Redesignates certain sex, prostitution, obscenity and sexual performance offenses committed against a child as class A-I felonies with a sentence of life imprisonment without parole.

bills.title: Establishes the John J. Marchi government studies scholarship program for certain CUNY students
bills.summary: Establishes the John J. Marchi government studies scholarship program for CUNY students enrolled in government or government related studies.

bills.title: Establishes class A-I felony of criminal use of a firearm for possessing a deadly weapon or displaying a gun during the commission of a class A or violent felony; repealer
bills.summary: Establishes the class A-I felony of criminal use of a firearm for possessing a deadly weapon or displaying what appears to be or is a rifle, pistol, revolver, shotgun, machine gun or other firearm during the commission of a class A or violent felony; repeals the offenses of criminal use of a firearm in the first and second degrees.

bills.title: Prohibits expenditure of state, local or public authority moneys relating to federal terrorism trials in the state of New York
bills.summary: Prohibits the expenditure of state, local and public authority moneys relating to any civilian criminal trial of enemy combatants for acts of terrorism in any federal court in the state of New York.

bills.title: Requires certain procedures for charter school students facing suspension
bills.summary: Requires certain procedures for charter school students facing suspension; makes such procedures consistent with other schools.

bills.title: Prohibits sex offenders from operating automobiles participating in mobile application based transportation networks or being employed by such transportation networks
bills.summary: Prohibits sex offenders from operating automobiles participating in mobile application based transportation networks or being employed by such transportation networks.

bills.title: Exempts certain paratransit eligible individuals from recertification requirements
bills.summary: Allows for paratransit eligible for paratransit eligible individuals who are at least eighty years old, to be required only to present correspondence from a licensed physician, dated within the preceding thirty days, indicating that the paratransit service is still necessary for the individual to make a single application for paratransit services; provides that once approved, such individuals shall be exempt from all certification requirements.

bills.title: Relates to exemptions from sales and use tax for books, candy, pictures, posters, trinkets, or any item containing a logo, collectable or seasonal item sold at a book fair or program
bills.summary: Relates to exemptions from sales and use tax for books, candy, pictures, posters, trinkets, or any item containing a logo, collectable or seasonal item sold at a book fair or program.

bills.title: Provides for the registration and regulation of pet groomers; establishes standards of care, training and testing
bills.summary: Provides for the registration and regulation of pet groomers; establishes standards of care, training and testing; provides such applicant must be at least eighteen years of age.

bills.title: Provides that when the governor declares a weather related state of emergency in a city having a population of one million or more, all public and private elementary and secondary schools shall be closed
bills.summary: Provides that when the governor declares a weather related state of emergency in a city having a population of one million or more, all public and private elementary and secondary schools shall be closed and remain closed until such emergency is terminated.

REFERRED TO VETERANS, HOMELAND SECURITY AND MILITARY AFFAIRS

bills.title: Relates to hate crimes and bail eligibility
bills.summary: Relates to hate crimes, as defined in article four hundred eighty-five of the penal law, and bail eligibility.

bills.title: Permits the commissioner of education to include graduate programs as programs eligible for approval under the state tuition assistance program
bills.summary: Permits the commissioner of education to include graduate programs as programs eligible for approval under the state tuition assistance program.

bills.title: Relates to license fees per barrel of petroleum ship through the state for use outside the state
bills.summary: Relates to license fees per barrel of petroleum shipped through the state for use outside the state by facilities within 1 mile of a similar facility in another state.

bills.title: Limits the substitution of abuse-deterrent analgesic opioid drug products for analgesic opioids lacking such technology
bills.summary: Provides for patient access to FDA approved abuse-deterrent technology to help combat opioid abuse.

bills.title: Provides for a tax credit for a certain amount of money expended on the care of a qualifying disabled child
bills.summary: Provides for a tax credit for a certain amount of money expended on the care of a qualifying disabled child.

bills.title: Relates to confidentiality of records in proceedings to vacate convictions for offenses resulting from sex trafficking, labor trafficking and compelling prostitution
bills.summary: Provides for confidentiality of records in proceedings to vacate convictions for offenses resulting from sex trafficking, labor trafficking and compelling prostitution.

bills.title: Directs the commissioner of health to promulgate rules and regulations to reduce the diversion of addiction medications
bills.summary: Directs the commissioner of the department of health to promulgate rules and regulations promoting recovery from opioid misuse and reducing diversion of addiction medicines.

items.text: REFERRED TO ALCOHOLISM AND SUBSTANCE USE DISORDERS
REFERRED TO ALCOHOLISM AND SUBSTANCE USE DISORDERS

bills.title: Requires hospital and emergency room physicians to notify a patient's prescriber that such patient is being treated for a controlled substance overdose
bills.summary: Requires hospital and emergency room physicians to consult the prescription monitoring program registry and to notify a patient's prescriber that such patient is being treated for a controlled substance overdose.

bills.title: Establishes the class C felony of assault of a patient in a mental health or developmental disability facility
bills.summary: Establishes the class C felony of assault of a patient in a mental health or developmental disability facility, for the intentional causation of physical injury to a patient residing in a facility operated, licensed or certified by the office of mental health or the office for people with developmental disabilities.

bills.title: Relates to health care and wellness education and outreach programs for preventing sudden cardiac arrest among student athletes
bills.summary: Relates to health care and wellness education and outreach programs for preventing sudden cardiac arrest among student athletes including recommending evidenced-based best practices for health certificates required pursuant to the education law, screening exams required for participation in interscholastic athletics, and information for students and their parents and guardians regarding sudden cardiac arrest.

bills.title: Relates to the application of special rebates and discounts to certain eligible energy users
bills.summary: Relates to the application of special rebates and discounts to certain eligible energy users that conduct a manufacturing activity within the city which produces new goods primarily from waste paper or other recyclables collected from residential sources in the city.

bills.title: Relates to the unlawful possession of a patient record
bills.summary: Relates to the unlawful possession of a patient record; makes such offense a class A misdemeanor.

bills.title: Directs that the flag to be flown at half-staff to commemorate the death of members of the United States armed forces who were residents of New York and were killed in action
bills.summary: Directs that the flag be flown at half-staff to commemorate the death of members of the United States armed forces who were residents of New York and were killed in action.

bills.title: Relates to requiring the commissioner of the department of civil service to prepare a report on certain civil service titles
bills.summary: Relates to requiring the commissioner of the department of civil service to prepare a report on civil service titles which require an appointee to possess a license and current registration as a mental health practitioner in one or more professions under article 163 of the education law.

items.text: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
AMEND (T) AND RECOMMIT TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
COMMITTEE DISCHARGED AND COMMITTED TO RULES

bills.title: Requires port authority to acquire economic impact statement prior to increasing bridge and tunnel tolls
bills.summary: Requires the port authority of New York and New Jersey to acquire an economic impact statement by an independent contractor at least 30 days prior to increasing bridge and tunnel tolls.

bills.title: Establishes the "education affordability act" and tax credit
bills.summary: Establishes the "education affordability act" and tax credit; provides credits against income and corporate franchise tax for various qualified education investments including scholarships, education funds and home-based instructional materials.

items.text: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

bills.title: Directs a city with a population of one million or more to reduce its real property tax levy
bills.summary: Directs a city with a population of one million or more to reduce its real property tax levy for the 2024 fiscal year by an amount not less than the real property tax increase authorized pursuant to local law 40 of the city of New York for the year 2002.

bills.title: Creates an appeals process for the district attorney
bills.summary: Relates to creating an appeals process for the district attorney in the county where the crime was committed where family members of a victim or persons residing in a county where an offender committed a crime can appeal the board's decision to release the offender if the offender committed certain criminal offenses.

bills.title: Requires persons issued a driver's license or permit to report the instance of a medically diagnosed seizure to the commissioner of motor vehicles
bills.summary: Requires a person issued a driver's license or permit to report the instance of a medically diagnosed seizure to the commissioner of motor vehicles within sixty days of such seizure.

bills.title: Directs the public service commission to implement rules requiring public utility companies to remove or relocate their utility poles when necessary for road improvements
bills.summary: Directs the public service commission to implement rules requiring public utility companies to remove or relocate their utility poles when necessary for road improvements.

bills.title: Allows vehicles bearing Purple Heart and disabled veteran plates to park in handicapped parking spaces
bills.summary: Allows vehicles bearing Purple Heart and disabled veteran plates to park in handicapped parking spaces.

bills.title: Provides that the borough of Staten Island shall also be known and designated as the "borough of parks"
bills.summary: Provides that the borough of Staten Island shall also be known and designated as the "borough of parks".

bills.title: Relates to warning labels on certain sports and muscle creams
bills.summary: Enacts Arielle's Law which requires the placement of warning labels on certain sports and muscle creams.

bills.title: Extends the moratorium on the issuance of environmental safety certificates for facilities and routes for the transportation of liquefied natural or petroleum gas
bills.summary: Extends the moratorium on the issuance of certificates of environmental safety for the siting of facilities and certification of routes for the transportation of liquefied natural or petroleum gas.

bills.title: Extends the time period for the conveyance of lands for the establishment of the Gateway National Recreation Area
bills.summary: Extends the time period for the conveyance of lands for the establishment of the Gateway National Recreation Area until June 30, 2025.

items.text: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.630

bills.title: Extends, until December 31, 2024, the authorization of residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds
bills.summary: Extends, from December 31, 2023 to December 31, 2024, the expiration of the authorization granted to residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds from their property.

bills.title: Provides for the application of the veterans' real property tax exemptions in the city of New York
bills.summary: Provides for the application of veterans' real property tax exemptions in cities having a population of one million or more.

REFERRED TO VETERANS, HOMELAND SECURITY AND MILITARY AFFAIRS

bills.title: Relates to appointments made by the governor and the senate
bills.summary: Provides that when an appointment to an office by the governor by and with the advice and consent of the senate is communicated, in the form of a written nomination of a person for the office, the senate shall wait at least thirty days to confirm or reject such nomination from the date such written nomination was received; makes related provisions.

items.text: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

bills.title: Relates to the contents of a notice of liability issued for a speed camera violation
bills.summary: Permits a violation captured by a speed camera to be dismissed upon the application of the person alleged to be liable for such violation if any information that is required to be inserted in the notice of liability is omitted from such notice of liability, misdescribed or illegible.

bills.title: Establishes domestic abuse offenses, provides for special information for certain felony domestic abuse offenses and designates such offenses as family offenses
bills.summary: Establishes domestic abuse offenses for assaults upon spouses, former spouses, fellow parents of a child in common and domestic partners; provides for issuance of a special information for domestic abuse in the first degree requiring a predicate criminal conviction; designates such domestic abuse offenses as family offenses for purposes of the criminal procedure law and the family court act.

bills.title: Authorizes certain organizations in N.Y. city to be known as "fire patrols" under the not-for-profit corporation law
bills.summary: Authorizes certain organizations in a city of one million or more to be known as "fire patrols" under the not-for-profit corporation law; includes fire patrol vehicles as emergency vehicles under the vehicle and traffic law.

items.text: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS

bills.title: Renames the Oakwood Beach wetland the Oakwood Beach-Detective Russel Timoshenko Preserve
bills.summary: Renames the Oakwood Beach wetland the Oakwood Beach-Detective Russel Timoshenko Preserve.

bills.title: Relates to references by a city school district in a city with a population of one million or more to public holidays
bills.summary: Relates to references by a city school district in a city with a population of one million or more to public holidays, specifically Columbus Day; provides that any literature or document created and/or distributed by such district do the same including school calendars.

items.text: REFERRED TO NEW YORK CITY EDUCATION
REFERRED TO NEW YORK CITY EDUCATION

bills.title: Exempts pet food from sales and compensating use taxes
bills.summary: Exempts pet food from sales and compensating use taxes.

bills.title: Prohibits a mandatory immunization against the novel coronavirus/COVID-19
bills.summary: Prohibits a mandatory immunization against the novel coronavirus/COVID-19 for children, incapacitated persons, or students or staff of employment institutions or day care facilities; prohibits requiring people to carry or present evidence of having received the COVID-19 vaccine.

bills.title: Relates to crimes committed on metropolitan transportation authority property
bills.summary: Makes a crime while in or upon metropolitan transportation authority property an A-1 felony; provides sentencing guidelines for such crime.

bills.title: Provides for notification to hospital patients upon intake of reports of hospital-acquired infections
bills.summary: Provides for notification to hospital patients upon intake of reports of hospital-acquired infections.

bills.title: Relates to resisting arrest
bills.summary: Relates to resisting arrest; reclassifies resisting arrest as a class E felony not eligible for release on an appearance ticket.

bills.title: Relates to false statements in documents submitted to the department of buildings of the city of New York
bills.summary: Relates to false statements in documents submitted to the department of buildings of the city of New York.

bills.title: Relates to protecting MTA workers from harassment
bills.summary: Expands the definition of aggravated harassment in the second degree to include harassing any MTA worker while performing their job duties.

bills.title: Relates to prohibiting mandatory immunization against the coronavirus
bills.summary: Prohibits mandatory immunization against the coronavirus; prohibits requiring immunization for attendance at school or day care, transportation, travel, entering public buildings, employment, nursing home residency or receiving government services; provides that no proof of vaccine shall be required or used; prohibits incentive for administering or receiving vaccination.

bills.title: Prevents municipalities from abridging the election law
bills.summary: Prevents municipalities from abridging the election law.

bills.title: Grants George Jensen an earlier starting date with the New York City Department of Sanitation
bills.summary: Grants George Jensen an earlier starting date with the New York City Department of Sanitation of August 1, 2021 as his current start date is November 1, 2021 due to a clerical error.

items.text: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS

bills.title: Establishes an alternatively assessed student program
bills.summary: Establishes an alternatively assessed student program in the New York City school district which allows one student, per school, per year, to be hired as a school aid in any public school within such district.

items.text: REFERRED TO NEW YORK CITY EDUCATION
REFERRED TO NEW YORK CITY EDUCATION

bills.title: Relates to tax credits for premiums paid for long-term care insurance
bills.summary: Provides that the tax credits for long-term health care insurance shall be up to $1,000 of the premiums paid for each policy of such insurance.

items.text: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

bills.title: Relates to the criminal use of a dangerous instrument on school grounds during the commission of a felony; repealer
bills.summary: Relates to the criminal use of a dangerous instrument on school grounds during the commission of a felony.

bills.title: Relates to the regulation of fifth generation (5G) telecommunications towers in cities with a population of one million or more
bills.summary: Prohibits the placement of fifth generation (5G) telecommunications towers within 250 feet of a business or residence in cities with a population of one million or more without the owner's consent; requires community board approval and the completion of a city environmental quality review before the placement of any 5G tower can be approved.

bills.title: Increases the maximum qualifying income for the senior citizen homeowner's exemption and the disabled homeowner's exemption
bills.summary: Increases the maximum qualifying income for the senior citizen homeowner's exemption and the disabled homeowner's exemption to $70,000 in the city of New York.

items.text: REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT

bills.title: Reclassifies court officers and court clerks of the unified court system under the definition of police officer; repealer
bills.summary: Reclassifies court officers and court clerks of the unified court system under the definition of police officer.

bills.title: Authorizes insurers to allow the insured to take and submit photographs of their automobile for purposes of the issuance or renewal of a policy of automobile physical damage insurance
bills.summary: Authorizes insurers to allow the insured to take and submit photographs of their automobile for purposes of the issuance or renewal of a policy of automobile physical damage insurance.

bills.title: Relates to appointments to the water board of the city of New York
bills.summary: Relates to appointments to the water board of the city of New York; specifies who shall appoint each member.

items.text: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS

bills.title: Authorizes the New York city water board to grant a discount on New York city water bills to senior citizens and veterans
bills.summary: Authorizes the New York city water board to grant a 10 percent discount on NYC water bills to senior citizens and veterans.

items.text: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS

bills.title: Exempts certain officers of the departments of correction and sanitation of the city of New York from training requirements for security guards
bills.summary: Exempts certain officers of the department of correction and the department of sanitation of the city of New York from training requirements for security guards; designates correction officers of New York city as peace officers.

bills.title: Increases the in-person appearance requirements for level two sex offenders
bills.summary: Increases the in-person appearance requirements for level two sex offenders from every three years to every year.

items.text: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION

bills.title: Prohibits disposal of spoils containing toxic pollutants into the waters of the marine district
bills.summary: Prohibits the disposal of any dredged spoils containing toxic pollutants into the waters of the marine district.

bills.title: Relates to the declaration of a sign as a public nuisance and its removal
bills.summary: Relates to the declaration of a sign as a public nuisance and its removal by order of the commissioner.

bills.title: Authorizes the temporary occupancy, for compensation, of a class A multiple dwelling that is a cooperative or condominium unit under certain conditions
bills.summary: Authorizes the temporary occupancy, for compensation, of a class A multiple dwelling that is a cooperative or condominium unit under certain conditions.

items.text: REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT

bills.title: Relates to the registered weight of tow trucks
bills.summary: Increases, from 8,600 pounds to 10,000 pounds, the gross vehicle weight rating of vehicles engaged in commercial towing that must be registered as tow trucks.

bills.title: Allows for distinctive plates to be issued for members of the New York city fire riders motorcycle club
bills.summary: Allows for distinctive plates to be issued for members of the New York city fire riders motorcycle club.

items.text: COMMITTEE DISCHARGED AND COMMITTED TO RULES

bills.title: Directs the MTA to rename the Eltingville transit center the Iraq War and Afghanistan War Veterans' Memorial Transit Center
bills.summary: Directs the MTA to rename the Eltingville transit center the Iraq War and Afghanistan War Veterans' Memorial Transit Center; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

bills.title: Grants court reporters in the first and second departments peace officer status
bills.summary: Relates to granting certain court reporters peace officer status; includes requirements for possession or a firearm.

bills.title: Establishes the class C felony offense of assault on a school employee
bills.summary: Establishes the class C felony offense of assault on a school employee for the intentional causing of physical injury to a school employee while upon school grounds.

bills.title: Provides for immediate notification to a complainant of the service of an ex parte order of protection
bills.summary: Provides for immediate notification to a complainant, in the manner specified by the complainant, of the service of an ex parte order of protection.

bills.title: Requires law enforcement and courts to notify the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency when an arrested person or defendant is not a United States citizen; repealer
bills.summary: Requires law enforcement and courts to notify the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency (ICE) when an arrested person or defendant is not a United States citizen; adjusts certain maximum sentences for class A misdemeanors and unclassified misdemeanors; requires notification to be made to the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency prior to the release of certain noncitizens; repeals provisions of the "protect our courts act".

bills.title: Relates to the common core state standards initiative
bills.summary: Relates to the common core state standards initiative; establishes the department shall discontinue implementation of the common core state standards.

bills.title: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to develop guidelines for transportation of students on field trips
bills.summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to develop guidelines for transportation of students on field trips.

bills.title: Relates to the crime of endangering the welfare of a child
bills.summary: Creates a new class D violent felony offense of endangering the welfare of a child in the first degree; converts the current offense of endangering the welfare of a child to a second degree crime.

bills.title: Provides for a personal income tax deduction for school supplies paid for out-of-pocket by K-12 teachers in public and nonpublic schools, up to $500 per year
bills.summary: Provides for a personal income tax deduction for school supplies paid for out-of-pocket by K-12 teachers in public and nonpublic schools, up to $500 per year.

bills.title: Requires utilities to charge not-for-profit organized sports programs for youth residential rates
bills.summary: Requires gas and electric corporations to charge not-for-profit organized sports programs for youth residential rates for utilities.

bills.title: Exempts institutions of higher education from the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax
bills.summary: Exempts institutions of higher education from the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax.

bills.title: Provides that certain sex offenders who are released on parole or sentenced to probation may not enter public, association or free libraries
bills.summary: Provides that certain sex offenders who are released on parole may not enter public, association or free libraries.

bills.title: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have surveillance cameras in the common areas of their residential facilities
bills.summary: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have surveillance cameras in the common areas of their residential facilities.

bills.title: Relates to creating the multi-disciplinary team demonstration program for complex cases of adult abuse, neglect, or financial exploitation
bills.summary: Relates to creating the multi-disciplinary team demonstration program for complex cases of adult abuse, neglect, or financial exploitation.

bills.title: Establishes the class E felony of official interference with transportation
bills.summary: Establishes the class E felony of official interference with transportation by a public servant.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates the New York state autism council; establishes such council shall consist of sixteen members; establishes the duties of the council.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to work hours for lifeguards
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that students may be employed for up to five hours on any day preceding a school day as a qualified lifeguard or aquatic supervisory staff, provided that the employer receives and maintains both the written consent of the minor's parent or guardian and a certificate which shall be provided to the employer at the end of each marking period by the minor's school which shall assert that such minor is in satisfactory academic standing.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires the owner of an altered livery vehicle upon inspection and registration to provide certification stating the length of the center panel of such vehicle
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires the owner of an altered livery vehicle upon inspection and registration to provide certification stating the length of the center panel of such vehicle and whether such center panel exceeds one hundred inches; further requires the commissioner of motor vehicles, beginning in 2011, to include in the department of motor vehicles annual summary registrations regarding the number of altered liveries with center panels one hundred inches or less and exceeding one hundred inches; and further requires such commissioner, beginning in 2011, to make available on-line all forms necessary to make certifications with respect to altered livery vehicles.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to requiring notice to neighboring landowners of intention to develop in wetland areas
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to requiring notice to neighboring landowners within one thousand feet of intention to develop in wetland areas; requires a public hearing on a wetland application.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for the continuation of express bus service to the south shore of Staten Island
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for the establishment of express bus service to the south shore of Staten Island.

all_lanza_bills.title: Creates "Arielle's law"; provides that any sport or muscle cream sold or given away must have a warning label if it contains methyl salicylate
all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates "Arielle's law; provides that any sport or muscle cream sold or given away must have a warning label if it contains methyl salicylate; provides that each violation is subject to a fine, not to exceed five hundred dollars.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits any little league from allowing its participants to use any bat other than one made from wood
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits any little league from allowing its participants to use any bat other than one made from wood.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires gas and electric corporations to charge not-for-profit organized sports programs for youth residential rates for utilities.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for certain retirement benefits for members employed by the New York state department of taxation and finance as peace officers or police officers upon completion of twenty-five years of creditable service.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for a demonstration project for the use of enforcement cameras on high occupancy vehicle and bus lanes on the Staten Island Expressway.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that new streets within and abutting streets of new commercial projects in the city of New York be the maximum legal width
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that new streets within and abutting streets of new commercial projects in the city of New York be the maximum legal width; prohibits any waiver of such requirement.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires coverage of orally administered chemotherapy treatments
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires coverage of orally administered chemotherapy treatments.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the crime of endangering the welfare of a child
all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates a new class D violent felony offense of endangering the welfare of a child in the first degree; the current offense of endangering the welfare of a child is converted to the second degree crime.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates the crime of falsely accusing someone of a crime.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to sales and compensating use taxes on certain machinery and equipment at a marine terminal facility located in a city with a population of one million or more
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that certain machinery and equipment for use directly and predominantly in loading, unloading and handling cargo carried by commercial ships at a marine terminal facility located in a city with a population of one million or more which is exempt from state sales and compensating use taxes shall not be exempt from city sales taxes.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires the Triborough bridge and tunnel authority to remove unused eastbound toll booths from the Verrazano-Narrows bridge.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to arson in the first degree
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes a person is guilty of arson in the first degree when he intentionally damages a building or motor vehicle by causing an explosion or a fire and when such explosion or fire is accelerated by use of ignitable liquid or flammable gas.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases the number of members of the metropolitan transportation authority from 16 to 18 and requires the appointees recommended by the mayor be from each of the five boroughs.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to electric generating facilities operating within five hundred feet of a residence
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that certain electric generating facilities operating within five hundred feet of a residence shall not be permitted to operate unless the demand for electrical capacity exceeds the daily forecast for the city of New York as determined by the public service commission the day prior to such operation; requires the shut down of certain facilities.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for presumptive eligibility for workers' compensation for certain persons engaged in World Trade Center rescue, recovery, or cleanup operations
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for presumptive eligibility for workers' compensation benefits for certain persons engaged in World Trade Center rescue, recovery, or cleanup operations; requires having passed a physical examination for entry into public service which did not disclose the basis for the disability; sets criteria for qualifying for and qualifying condition or impairment of health; defines applicable work sites; establishes procedure for filing for claims.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for a tax credit for a certain amount of money expended on the care of a qualifying disabled child
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for a tax credit for a certain amount of money expended on the care of a qualifying disabled child.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that the city of New York shall provide health insurance coverage for the wife and sons of deceased metropolitan transportation authority worker Andrew Greaves.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that pet dealers or other persons shall not sell dogs purchased or received from a puppy mill.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that the failure to report a release of hazardous substances is a class A misdemeanor and any such subsequent violation shall be a class E felony.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for family members of a crime victim and interested parties to make statements to members of the parole board; provides that such oral statement shall be made to the members of the state board of parole who will determine whether the defendant is released.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the advertising of tobacco products on mass commuting vehicles receiving state aid or funding; includes buses, subway car, rail, locomotive; includes stations and waiting areas.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the transloading of municipal solid waste, toxic waste or hazardous wastes at facilities in Richmond county unless such waste originates in such county except after an environmental impact study and a public hearing or unless such waste is received in an unopened container which is subsequently shipped out of such county.

all_lanza_bills.title: Creates the crimes of dangerous driving in the fifth, fourth, third, second and first degrees
all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates the crimes of dangerous driving in the fifth, fourth, third, second and first degrees; imposes criminal liability on drivers who continue to operate motor vehicles in violation of the vehicle and traffic law and cause injury as a result.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires presence of conductors on all passenger railroad trains operated by the Staten Island railroad.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for payment of a bonus to members of the armed forces from this state for service during the period of hostilities in Korea, Vietnam or the Persian Gulf
all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes creation of a state debt for payment of a bonus to members of the armed forces from this state for service during the period of the Korean, Vietnam or Persian Gulf hostilities of a maximum of $400 for overseas service and $300 for stateside service.

all_lanza_bills.title: Creates crimes for disruption of funerals
all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates crimes for disruption of funerals; establishes the crimes of disorderly conduct in the first and second degrees and establishes the crimes of disruption of meetings in the first and second degrees.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that window guards shall be required on all fire escape windows in multiple dwellings
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires the owner, lessee, agent or other person who manages or controls a multiple dwelling to provide, install, and maintain, a window guard on the windows of each apartment in which a child or children ten years of age or under reside, and on the windows, if any, in the public halls of a multiple dwelling in which such children reside; prohibits a padlock, key lock, combination lock or any other locking mechanism on any window guard, except that such window guards may be secured with a latch system that is capable of releasing in such a manner that immediate access to such fire escape is not impeded; provides that any violation shall constitute a civil violation subject to a penalty of not more than five hundred dollars per violation.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for the licensing of docking pilots in the waters of the port of New York and the ports of New Jersey and for criminal history checks of applicants for such licenses; requires the engagement of a Sandy Hook pilot or docking pilot in certain such waters; expands regulatory powers of board of commissioners of pilots regarding Sandy Hook pilots on such waters, and authorizes the board to issue photo identification cards to licensed pilots.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to disputes arising from use of an electronic toll collection system
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that claims arising from use of an electronic toll collection system may be filed in the appropriate court in the county in which the claimant resides; requires any contract or agreement between a consumer and a public authority which provides for use of a system or device facilitating electronic toll collection to clearly state the name, address and telephone number of the legal entity with which the consumer is contracting for service; to clearly state, in a separate section, how and where a consumer may challenge any changes made on his or her account; and to include specific contact information relating to settling disputes relating to charges as well as identifying the court in which a claim may be brought, the statute of limitations for such claim and any steps which a claimant may be required to take before making a claim.
