all_lanza_bills.title: Requires portable electronic devices distributed after January 1, 2022 to automatically disable their texting and computer functions when the holder is operating a motor vehicle over 10 miles an hour
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires portable electronic devices distributed after January 1, 2022 to automatically disable their texting and computer functions when the holder is operating a motor vehicle over 10 miles an hour; eliminates the exemption from provisions, relating to the use of portable electronic devices in motor vehicles, granted to commercial motor vehicles, police, firefighters and emergency vehicle operators.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to exempting clothing and footwear sold in New York city from all sales taxes
all_lanza_bills.summary: Exempts clothing and footwear sold in New York city from all state and local sales taxes including items used or consumed to make or repair such clothing and which becomes a physical component part of such clothing.

items.text: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to electronic citation fees
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to electronic citation fees or the process of transmitting traffic, misdemeanor, municipal ordinance, conservation, or other citations and law enforcement data via electronic means to a county clerk.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to establishing the John J. Marchi government studies scholarship program for certain CUNY students
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the John J. Marchi government studies scholarship program for CUNY students enrolled in government or government related studies.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires investigation of school district personnel involved with the care, custody or supervision of a child
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires pre-employment investigation of school district personnel to determine criminal history or the presence of controlled substances or communicable diseases; requires submission to fingerprinting and other tests.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to providing an exemption for lifeguard services
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to providing an exemption from sales and compensating use taxes for lifeguard services provided by a qualified lifeguard or aquatic supervisory staff.

items.text: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that it shall not be discrimination when a person's immutable attribute, characteristic or trait, or religious belief, marital status or disability interferes with ability to meet employment requirements
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that it shall not be harassment or discrimination when a person's immutable attribute, characteristic or trait, or his or her religious belief, marital status or disability interferes with such individual's ability to meet employment requirements.

items.text: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the possession, manufacture or sale of a trigger crank, a bump-fire device or other firing accelerators
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the possession, manufacture or sale of a trigger crank, a bump-fire device or other firing accelerators.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the Move New York Fair Plan
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the Move New York Fair Plan; creates a Move New York mobility fund, provides for outer bridges to be tolled in accordance with a specified ratio, provides for a taxi surcharge on certain vehicles, rescinds certain provisions of the tax law, and establishes authority for the receipt and disbursement of realized funds; directs the metropolitan transportation authority to contract with a certified public accounting firm for the conducting of an independent forensic audit of such authority.

all_lanza_bills.title: Enacts Michelle and Jordan's law relating to the penalties for a second conviction of participating in an unlawful speed contest or race
all_lanza_bills.summary: Enacts Michelle and Jordan's law relating to the penalties for a second conviction of participating in an unlawful speed contest or race.

all_lanza_bills.title: Increases number of supreme court justices in the thirteenth judicial district to ten and in the second judicial district to fifty-two
all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases the number of supreme court justices in the thirteenth judicial district to ten and in the second judicial district to fifty-two.

all_lanza_bills.title: Exempts mortgages of residential real property from taxation when property is purchased by owners receiving state or federal buyout of prior residence destroyed in hurricane Sandy
all_lanza_bills.summary: Exempts mortgages of residential real property from taxation when property is purchased by owners receiving state or federal buyout of their prior residence destroyed in hurricane Sandy.

items.text: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Redesignates certain sex, prostitution, obscenity and sexual performance offenses committed against a child as class A-I felonies with a sentence of life imprisonment without parole
all_lanza_bills.summary: Redesignates certain sex, prostitution, obscenity and sexual performance offenses committed against a child as class A-I felonies with a sentence of life imprisonment without parole.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes limitations upon real property tax levies in cities of over 1,000,000
all_lanza_bills.summary: Limits, in cities having a population of one million or more, the annual increase in real property taxes.

all_lanza_bills.title: Makes the inability to pay child support an affirmative defense to non-support of child offenses, rather than an element of such offenses
all_lanza_bills.summary: Makes the inability to pay child support an affirmative defense to non-support of child offenses, rather than an element of such offenses.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that conviction of assault on a social worker which prevents him or her from performing a lawful duty is a felony
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that conviction of assault on a social worker which prevents him or her from performing a lawful duty is a felony.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the class D felony of criminal street gang recruitment on school grounds
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the class D felony of criminal street gang recruitment on school grounds which occurs when an individual on school grounds coerces, solicits, recruits or induces another person to join or remain a member of a criminal street gang, or conspires to do so.

all_lanza_bills.title: Expands the class A misdemeanor of public lewdness in the first degree to include the commission of public lewdness after having been convicted of a public lewdness offense in the previous 3 years
all_lanza_bills.summary: Expands the class A misdemeanor of public lewdness in the first degree to include the commission of public lewdness after having been convicted of a public lewdness offense in the previous 3 years.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the class E felony of official interference with transportation
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the class E felony of official interference with transportation.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the criminal use of a dangerous instrument on school grounds during the commission of a felony
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the criminal use of a dangerous instrument on school grounds during the commission of a felony.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for family members of a crime victim and interested parties to make statements to members of the parole board
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for family members of a crime victim and interested parties to make statements to members of the parole board; provides that such oral statement shall be made to the members of the state board of parole who will determine whether the defendant is released.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes class A-I felony of criminal use of a firearm for possessing a deadly weapon or displaying a gun during the commission of a class A or violent felony; repealer
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the class A-I felony of criminal use of a firearm for possessing a deadly weapon or displaying what appears to be or is a rifle, pistol, revolver, shotgun, machine gun or other firearm during the commission of a class A or violent felony; repeals the offenses of criminal use of a firearm in the first and second degrees.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that rape in the first degree shall be a class A-I felony
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that rape in the first degree shall be a class A-I felony and shall be punishable by life imprisonment without parole.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the enforcement of provisions relating to carriers of household goods by motor vehicles
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the enforcement of provisions relating to carriers of household goods by motor vehicle; authorizes the attorney general to seek an injunction to enjoin and restrain the continuance or threat of certain violations by such carriers.

all_lanza_bills.title: Creates the crimes of dangerous driving in the fifth, fourth, third, second and first degrees
all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates the crimes of dangerous driving in the fifth, fourth, third, second and first degrees; imposes criminal liability on drivers who continue to operate motor vehicles in violation of the vehicle and traffic law and cause injury as a result.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for sentence of life without parole for defendants convicted of certain sex offenses against a child or mentally disabled person; repealer
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for the imposition of a sentence of life imprisonment without parole for defendants convicted of certain sex offenses against a child or mentally disabled person.

all_lanza_bills.title: Imposes strict liability on manufacturers, owners, and operators of unmanned motor vehicles
all_lanza_bills.summary: Imposes strict liability on manufacturers, owners, and operators of unmanned motor vehicles.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have surveillance cameras in the common areas of their residential facilities
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have surveillance cameras in the common areas of their residential facilities.

REFERRED TO MENTAL HEALTH AND DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to penalties for aggravated cruelty to animals.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to penalties for committing multiple animal cruelty offenses
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to penalties for committing multiple animal cruelty offenses.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the right of adoptees to receive a certified copy of their birth certificate upon reaching the age of 18
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the right of adoptees to receive a certified copy of their birth certificate upon reaching the age of 18; such birth certificate shall include information on the medical history of the birth parents.

all_lanza_bills.title: Extends, until December 31, 2020, the authorization of residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds
all_lanza_bills.summary: Extends, from December 31, 2019 to December 31, 2020, the expiration of the authorization granted to residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds from their property.

items.text: COMMITTEE DISCHARGED AND COMMITTED TO RULES

all_lanza_bills.title: Grants eligibility for the tax abatement for industrial and commercial construction work in cities having a population of one million or more, to certain electric generating facilities
all_lanza_bills.summary: Grants eligibility for the tax abatement for industrial and commercial construction work in cities having a population of one million or more, to certain electric generating facilities the operation of which commenced in 2012.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to collective employment negotiations, notice of the issuance of debt and capital plans and projects of the port authority of New York and New Jersey
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to collective employment negotiations, notice of the issuance of debt and capital plans and projects of the port authority of New York and New Jersey.

REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires the commissioner of health to establish and publish a list of generic drug products; repealer
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires the commissioner of health to establish and publish a list of generic drug products.

all_lanza_bills.title: Enacts the child custody reform act
all_lanza_bills.summary: Enacts the child custody reform act to provide uniform statewide standards for the litigation and mediation of child custody disputes; provides for an initial planning conference between the judge and all parties to attempt a settlement; provides for mediation unless the court finds mediation is inappropriate; requires the chief administrator of the courts to establish plans for the conduct of administration of the mediation and preparation of evaluation reports.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to sanctions for driving while ability impaired while holding a conditional license
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to sanctions for driving while ability impaired while holding a conditional license.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that certain sex offenders who are released on parole or sentenced to probation may not enter public, association or free libraries
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that certain sex offenders who are released on parole may not enter public, association or free libraries.

items.text: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION
REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for the application of the veterans' real property tax exemptions in the city of New York
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for the application of the veterans' real property tax exemptions in cities having a population of one million or more.

REFERRED TO VETERANS, HOMELAND SECURITY AND MILITARY AFFAIRS

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the penalty for unlawfully fleeing a uniformed police officer of the New York city taxi and limousine commission
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the penalty for unlawfully fleeing a uniformed police officer of the New York city taxi and limousine commission.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs the division of criminal justice services to annually provide a list of all level 2 and 3 sex offenders residing in a county, to the residents of such county
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to annually provide a list of all level 2 and 3 sex offenders residing in a county, to the residents of such county.

items.text: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION
REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for random testing for anabolic steroids in athletes in public and private schools; appropriation
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for random testing for anabolic steroids in athletes in public and private schools; appropriates $1,000,000 therefor.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to visitation and custody rights involving non-U.S. citizens
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits a court from providing for visitation or custody of a minor who is a U.S. citizen to a person who resides outside the U.S. when the other party to such action is a U.S. citizen and objects to such an order.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires utilities to charge not-for-profit organized sports programs for youth residential rates
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires gas and electric corporations to charge not-for-profit organized sports programs for youth residential rates for utilities.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that the fines for traffic infractions and traffic misdemeanors committed in a school traffic control zone are doubled
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that the fines for traffic infractions and traffic misdemeanors committed in a school traffic control zone are doubled; further requires such zones to be marked by a traffic light or stop sign.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to teen dating violence education programs
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to teen dating violence education programs; requires school districts to create policies, procedures and guidelines to implement education programs for students in kindergarten through twelfth grade to prevent, deter and address incidents of teen dating violence; defines teen dating violence.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to promoting understanding, awareness and enforcement of animal crimes laws; repealer
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to promoting understanding, awareness and enforcement of animal crime laws.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for a 75-25 percent split in the New York city transit authority's operating surplus between the authority and the Metropolitan transportation authority
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for a 75-25 percent split in the New York city transit authority's operating surplus between the authority and the Metropolitan transit authority where previously the split was 50-50.

all_lanza_bills.title: Expands the crimes included in domestic violence to include identity theft, grand larceny and coercion, for purposes of assistance to victims thereof
all_lanza_bills.summary: Expands the crimes included in domestic violence to include identity theft, grand larceny and coercion, for purposes of assistance to victims thereof.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits the parking of a vehicle greater than sixty inches in height within fifteen feet of an intersection
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the parking of a vehicle greater than sixty inches in height within fifteen feet of an intersection.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the registration and regulation of animal breeders
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the registration and regulation of animal breeders; requires each to be licensed; creates a breeder licensing fund; exempts not-for-profit organizations.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits the use of automated purchasing software to buy large quantities of goods for the purpose of retail resale
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the use of automated purchasing software to buy large quantities of goods for the purpose of retail resale of such goods.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that the failure to report a release of hazardous substances is a class A misdemeanor
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that the failure to report a release of hazardous substances is a class A misdemeanor and any such subsequent violation shall be a class E felony.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and findings thereon
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and the arbitrator's findings of fact and conclusions of law.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires a public hearing prior to procurements valued over one hundred thousand dollars are made overseas by public authorities
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires a public hearing before procurements valued over one hundred thousand dollars are made overseas by public authorities.

REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires a criminal history report for certain employment or volunteer applicants to the office for people with developmental disabilities
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the commissioner of the office for people with developmental disabilities to deny employment or volunteer applications based on a criminal history report for such applicant.

REFERRED TO MENTAL HEALTH AND DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that when the governor declares a weather related state of emergency in a city having a population of one million or more, all public and private elementary and secondary schools shall be closed
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that when the governor declares a weather related state of emergency in a city having a population of one million or more, all public and private elementary and secondary schools shall be closed and remain closed until such emergency is terminated.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to exemptions from sales and use tax for books, candy, pictures, posters, trinkets, or any item containing a logo, collectable or seasonal item sold at a book fair or program
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to exemptions from sales and use tax for books, candy, pictures, posters, trinkets, or any item containing a logo, collectable or seasonal item sold at a book fair or program.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to contract with a certified public accounting firm for the conducting of an independent forensic audit
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to contract with a certified public accounting firm for the conducting of an independent forensic audit of such authority.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to special powers of the metropolitan transportation authority
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to special powers of the authority; allows for paratransit eligible individuals who are at least eighty years old, to be required only to present correspondence from a licensed physician, dated within the preceding thirty days, indicating that the paratransit service is still necessary for the individual to make a single application for paratransit services; once approved, such individuals shall be exempt from all certification requirements.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that residential real property which sustained 50% or greater damage in Hurricane Sandy, and is rebuilt shall be assessed at its pre-Sandy market value
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that residential real property which sustained 50% or greater damage in Hurricane Sandy, and is rebuilt shall be assessed at its pre-Sandy market value.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to accessing records under the freedom of information law
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to accessing records under the freedom of information law including notification procedures and the release of names of natural persons and residential addresses.

items.text: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits monitoring of gas and electric meters any more frequently than on a monthly or billing cycle basis
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the monitoring, collection, recording or storing of data from gas and electric meters any more frequently than on a monthly or billing cycle basis, unless the express written consent of the consumer has been provided; and requires the consent of the property owner for entry upon residential property.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to expanding the eligibility period for indigent legal service attorneys
all_lanza_bills.summary: Expands the eligibility period for indigent legal service attorneys to receive certain loan forgiveness.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to increasing loan forgiveness for attorneys performing legal services for indigent clients
all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases loan reimbursement for certain attorneys who work in legal services with indigent clients from $3,400 to $5,500.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires employees of gaming facilities to undergo human-trafficking recognition training
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires employees of gaming facilities to undergo human-trafficking recognition training which shall address the nature of human trafficking, how human trafficking is defined in law, how to identify victims of human trafficking, relief and recovery options for survivors, and social and legal services available to victims.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the class C felony of assault of a patient in a mental health or developmental disability facility
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the class C felony of assault of a patient in a mental health or developmental disability facility, for the intentional causation of physical injury to a patient residing in a facility operated, licensed or certified by the office of mental health or the office for people with developmental disabilities.

all_lanza_bills.title: Allows commuter vans to accept hails from prospective passengers in the street; repealer
all_lanza_bills.summary: Allows commuter vans to accept hails from prospective passengers in the street.

all_lanza_bills.title: Authorizes and directs the department of health and the office for the aging to conduct a study of fees and charges assessed to residents of assisted living facilities
all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes and directs the department of health and the office for the aging to conduct a study of fees and charges assessed to residents of assisted living facilities and to make recommendations to the legislature.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs a city with a population of one million or more to reduce its real property tax levy
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs a city with a population of one million or more to reduce its real property tax levy for the 2020 fiscal year by an amount not less than the real property tax increase authorized pursuant to local law 40 of the city of New York for the year 2002.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the procedure followed by the justice center when responding to certain reportable incidents
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires the justice center to establish procedures for when to report incidents which include suspicious and unexplained injuries including broken bones, hematomas, open wounds beyond minor first aid, black eyes, swollen noses, extreme and questionable bruising, choke marks, burns, individuals found unresponsive and all deaths to a 9-1-1 operator.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to requiring the commissioner of the department of civil service to prepare a report on mental health practitioner classification.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the offenses of phishing in the third degree, phishing in the second degree and phishing in the first degree; and relates to the time in which prosecution of such offenses must be commenced.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to expediting actions involving insurance claims for damages resulting from a state disaster emergency
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to expediting actions involving insurance claims for damages resulting from a state disaster emergency.

all_lanza_bills.title: Conforms the New York state college choice tuition savings program to the federal qualified tuition program
all_lanza_bills.summary: Conforms the New York state college choice tuition savings program to the federal qualified tuition program so as to include savings for grades kindergarten through 12.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the unlawful possession of a patient record
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the unlawful possession of a patient record; a class A misdemeanor.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs the public service commission to implement rules requiring public utility companies to remove or relocate their utility poles when necessary for road improvements
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the public service commission to implement rules requiring public utility companies to remove or relocate their utility poles when necessary for road improvements.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to requiring persons issued a driver's license or permit to report the instance of a medically diagnosed seizure to the commissioner of motor vehicles
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires a person issued a driver's license or permit to report the instance of a medically diagnosed seizure to the commissioner of motor vehicles within sixty days of such seizure.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to waiving certain fees associated with the issuance of an enhanced driver's license
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to waiving all additional fees associated with the issuance of an enhanced driver's license if such license is required within thirty days of the issuance or reissuance of a standard driver's license.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to creating an appeals process for the district attorney
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to creating an appeals process for the district attorney in the county where the crime was committed where family members of a victim or persons residing in a county where an offender committed a crime can appeal the board's decision to release the offender if the offender committed certain criminal offenses.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires advertisements for certain accommodations to be submitted to designated enforcement agency
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires advertisements for certain accommodations to be submitted to designated enforcement agency.

REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for confidentiality of records in proceedings to vacate convictions for offenses resulting from sex trafficking, labor trafficking and compelling prostitution.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the application of special rebates and discounts to certain eligible energy users
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the application of special rebates and discounts to certain eligible energy users that conduct a manufacturing activity within the city which produces new goods primarily from waste paper or other recyclables collected from residential sources in the city.

all_lanza_bills.title: Amends the waterfront commission act
all_lanza_bills.summary: Amends the waterfront commission act, relating to empowering the waterfront commission to accept applications in the longshoremen's register.

REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to license fees per barrel of petroleum shipped through the state for use outside the state by facilities within 1 mile of a similar facility in another state.

all_lanza_bills.title: Authorizes certain organizations in N.Y. city to be known as "fire patrols" under the not-for-profit corporation law
all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes certain organizations in a city of one million or more to be known as "fire patrols" under the not-for-profit corporation law and includes fire patrol vehicles as emergency vehicles under the vehicle and traffic law.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for the financing of emergency room facilities in two hospitals in each borough by the New York city health and hospitals corporation and requires representation on the board from each borough.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Enacts "Cesar's law" to require the retaking of parolees, who abscond from the supervision of the state board of parole.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes emergency medical care personnel to provide basic first aid to dogs and cats.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates a college preparation expense tax credit for up to three years per child/individual for up to $500 per year for qualified college preparation expenses.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to instant run-off elections in the city of New York for any city wide elections for the office of mayor, public advocate or comptroller.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases the in-person appearance requirements for level two sex offenders from every three years to every year.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Restricts the segregated confinement of pregnant inmates to situations where there are exceptional circumstances which would create an unacceptable risk to other inmates or staff.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that an automobile insurer may waive the inspection of a private passenger automobile prior to providing physical damage coverage.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes cities having a population of one million or more to provide a rebate during a specified city fiscal year of a portion of the real property taxes on owner occupied 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6 family residential real property, or residential real property held in the condominium or cooperative form of ownership.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes insurers to allow the insured to take and submit photographs of their automobile for purposes of the issuance or renewal of a policy of automobile physical damage insurance.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the declaration of a sign as a public nuisance and its removal by order of the commissioner.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires notaries public and commissioners of deeds to complete and retain certain documents relating to the transfer of residential real property.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes a personal income tax credit for the purchase of a gun safe
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes up to a $500 personal income tax credit for the purchase of a gun safe.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to authorizing uniformed court officers and court clerks designated as peace officers to execute arrest warrants.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to making all single occupancy bathrooms gender neutral in school districts, charter schools, SUNY, CUNY, community colleges, restaurants, bars, mercantile establishments, factories and state-owned or operated buildings.

all_lanza_bills.title: Authorizes localities to waive citizenship requirements for certain police and firefighters in their jurisdictions
all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes localities to waive citizenship requirements for certain police and firefighters in their jurisdictions.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes the temporary occupancy, for compensation, of a class A multiple dwelling that is a cooperative or condominium unit under certain conditions.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to preneed insurance premiums.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to penalties for intent to cause injury to an animal.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to penalties for causing the death of an animal
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to penalties for causing the death of an animal; class D felony.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to enhanced penalties for aggravated cruelty to animals
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to enhanced penalties for aggravated cruelty to animals.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires portable electronic devices distributed after January 1, 2022 to automatically disable their texting and computer functions when the holder is operating a motor vehicle over 10 miles an hour
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires portable electronic devices distributed after January 1, 2022 to automatically disable their texting and computer functions when the holder is operating a motor vehicle over 10 miles an hour; eliminates the exemption from provisions, relating to the use of portable electronic devices in motor vehicles, granted to commercial motor vehicles, police, firefighters and emergency vehicle operators.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to exempting clothing and footwear sold in New York city from all sales taxes
all_lanza_bills.summary: Exempts clothing and footwear sold in New York city from all state and local sales taxes including items used or consumed to make or repair such clothing and which becomes a physical component part of such clothing.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to electronic citation fees
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to electronic citation fees or the process of transmitting traffic, misdemeanor, municipal ordinance, conservation, or other citations and law enforcement data via electronic means to a county clerk.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to establishing the John J. Marchi government studies scholarship program for certain CUNY students
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the John J. Marchi government studies scholarship program for CUNY students enrolled in government or government related studies.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires investigation of school district personnel involved with the care, custody or supervision of a child
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires pre-employment investigation of school district personnel to determine criminal history or the presence of controlled substances or communicable diseases; requires submission to fingerprinting and other tests.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to providing an exemption for lifeguard services
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to providing an exemption from sales and compensating use taxes for lifeguard services provided by a qualified lifeguard or aquatic supervisory staff.

REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that it shall not be discrimination when a person's immutable attribute, characteristic or trait, or religious belief, marital status or disability interferes with ability to meet employment requirements
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that it shall not be harassment or discrimination when a person's immutable attribute, characteristic or trait, or his or her religious belief, marital status or disability interferes with such individual's ability to meet employment requirements.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the possession, manufacture or sale of a trigger crank, a bump-fire device or other firing accelerators.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the Move New York Fair Plan
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the Move New York Fair Plan; creates a Move New York mobility fund, provides for outer bridges to be tolled in accordance with a specified ratio, provides for a taxi surcharge on certain vehicles, rescinds certain provisions of the tax law, and establishes authority for the receipt and disbursement of realized funds; directs the metropolitan transportation authority to contract with a certified public accounting firm for the conducting of an independent forensic audit of such authority.

all_lanza_bills.title: Enacts Michelle and Jordan's law relating to the penalties for a second conviction of participating in an unlawful speed contest or race
all_lanza_bills.summary: Enacts Michelle and Jordan's law relating to the penalties for a second conviction of participating in an unlawful speed contest or race.

all_lanza_bills.title: Increases number of supreme court justices in the thirteenth judicial district to ten and in the second judicial district to fifty-two
all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases the number of supreme court justices in the thirteenth judicial district to ten and in the second judicial district to fifty-two.

all_lanza_bills.title: Exempts mortgages of residential real property from taxation when property is purchased by owners receiving state or federal buyout of prior residence destroyed in hurricane Sandy
all_lanza_bills.summary: Exempts mortgages of residential real property from taxation when property is purchased by owners receiving state or federal buyout of their prior residence destroyed in hurricane Sandy.

items.text: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Redesignates certain sex, prostitution, obscenity and sexual performance offenses committed against a child as class A-I felonies with a sentence of life imprisonment without parole
all_lanza_bills.summary: Redesignates certain sex, prostitution, obscenity and sexual performance offenses committed against a child as class A-I felonies with a sentence of life imprisonment without parole.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes limitations upon real property tax levies in cities of over 1,000,000
all_lanza_bills.summary: Limits, in cities having a population of one million or more, the annual increase in real property taxes.

all_lanza_bills.title: Makes the inability to pay child support an affirmative defense to non-support of child offenses, rather than an element of such offenses
all_lanza_bills.summary: Makes the inability to pay child support an affirmative defense to non-support of child offenses, rather than an element of such offenses.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that conviction of assault on a social worker which prevents him or her from performing a lawful duty is a felony
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that conviction of assault on a social worker which prevents him or her from performing a lawful duty is a felony.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the class D felony of criminal street gang recruitment on school grounds
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the class D felony of criminal street gang recruitment on school grounds which occurs when an individual on school grounds coerces, solicits, recruits or induces another person to join or remain a member of a criminal street gang, or conspires to do so.

all_lanza_bills.title: Expands the class A misdemeanor of public lewdness in the first degree to include the commission of public lewdness after having been convicted of a public lewdness offense in the previous 3 years
all_lanza_bills.summary: Expands the class A misdemeanor of public lewdness in the first degree to include the commission of public lewdness after having been convicted of a public lewdness offense in the previous 3 years.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the class E felony of official interference with transportation
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the class E felony of official interference with transportation.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the criminal use of a dangerous instrument on school grounds during the commission of a felony
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the criminal use of a dangerous instrument on school grounds during the commission of a felony.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for family members of a crime victim and interested parties to make statements to members of the parole board
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for family members of a crime victim and interested parties to make statements to members of the parole board; provides that such oral statement shall be made to the members of the state board of parole who will determine whether the defendant is released.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes class A-I felony of criminal use of a firearm for possessing a deadly weapon or displaying a gun during the commission of a class A or violent felony; repealer
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the class A-I felony of criminal use of a firearm for possessing a deadly weapon or displaying what appears to be or is a rifle, pistol, revolver, shotgun, machine gun or other firearm during the commission of a class A or violent felony; repeals the offenses of criminal use of a firearm in the first and second degrees.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that rape in the first degree shall be a class A-I felony
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that rape in the first degree shall be a class A-I felony and shall be punishable by life imprisonment without parole.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the enforcement of provisions relating to carriers of household goods by motor vehicles
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the enforcement of provisions relating to carriers of household goods by motor vehicle; authorizes the attorney general to seek an injunction to enjoin and restrain the continuance or threat of certain violations by such carriers.

all_lanza_bills.title: Creates the crimes of dangerous driving in the fifth, fourth, third, second and first degrees
all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates the crimes of dangerous driving in the fifth, fourth, third, second and first degrees; imposes criminal liability on drivers who continue to operate motor vehicles in violation of the vehicle and traffic law and cause injury as a result.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for sentence of life without parole for defendants convicted of certain sex offenses against a child or mentally disabled person; repealer
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for the imposition of a sentence of life imprisonment without parole for defendants convicted of certain sex offenses against a child or mentally disabled person.

all_lanza_bills.title: Imposes strict liability on manufacturers, owners, and operators of unmanned motor vehicles
all_lanza_bills.summary: Imposes strict liability on manufacturers, owners, and operators of unmanned motor vehicles.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have surveillance cameras in the common areas of their residential facilities
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have surveillance cameras in the common areas of their residential facilities.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to penalties for committing multiple animal cruelty offenses.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the right of adoptees to receive a certified copy of their birth certificate upon reaching the age of 18; such birth certificate shall include information on the medical history of the birth parents.

all_lanza_bills.title: Extends, until December 31, 2020, the authorization of residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds
all_lanza_bills.summary: Extends, from December 31, 2019 to December 31, 2020, the expiration of the authorization granted to residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds from their property.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to collective employment negotiations, notice of the issuance of debt and capital plans and projects of the port authority of New York and New Jersey.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires the commissioner of health to establish and publish a list of generic drug products.

all_lanza_bills.title: Enacts the child custody reform act
all_lanza_bills.summary: Enacts the child custody reform act to provide uniform statewide standards for the litigation and mediation of child custody disputes; provides for an initial planning conference between the judge and all parties to attempt a settlement; provides for mediation unless the court finds mediation is inappropriate; requires the chief administrator of the courts to establish plans for the conduct of administration of the mediation and preparation of evaluation reports.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to sanctions for driving while ability impaired while holding a conditional license.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that certain sex offenders who are released on parole may not enter public, association or free libraries.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to annually provide a list of all level 2 and 3 sex offenders residing in a county, to the residents of such county.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for random testing for anabolic steroids in athletes in public and private schools; appropriates $1,000,000 therefor.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to visitation and custody rights involving non-U.S. citizens
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits a court from providing for visitation or custody of a minor who is a U.S. citizen to a person who resides outside the U.S. when the other party to such action is a U.S. citizen and objects to such an order.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires utilities to charge not-for-profit organized sports programs for youth residential rates
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires gas and electric corporations to charge not-for-profit organized sports programs for youth residential rates for utilities.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that the fines for traffic infractions and traffic misdemeanors committed in a school traffic control zone are doubled
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that the fines for traffic infractions and traffic misdemeanors committed in a school traffic control zone are doubled; further requires such zones to be marked by a traffic light or stop sign.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to teen dating violence education programs
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to teen dating violence education programs; requires school districts to create policies, procedures and guidelines to implement education programs for students in kindergarten through twelfth grade to prevent, deter and address incidents of teen dating violence; defines teen dating violence.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to promoting understanding, awareness and enforcement of animal crimes laws; repealer
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to promoting understanding, awareness and enforcement of animal crime laws.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for a 75-25 percent split in the New York city transit authority's operating surplus between the authority and the Metropolitan transportation authority
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for a 75-25 percent split in the New York city transit authority's operating surplus between the authority and the Metropolitan transit authority where previously the split was 50-50.

all_lanza_bills.title: Expands the crimes included in domestic violence to include identity theft, grand larceny and coercion, for purposes of assistance to victims thereof
all_lanza_bills.summary: Expands the crimes included in domestic violence to include identity theft, grand larceny and coercion, for purposes of assistance to victims thereof.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits the parking of a vehicle greater than sixty inches in height within fifteen feet of an intersection
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the parking of a vehicle greater than sixty inches in height within fifteen feet of an intersection.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the registration and regulation of animal breeders
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the registration and regulation of animal breeders; requires each to be licensed; creates a breeder licensing fund; exempts not-for-profit organizations.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits the use of automated purchasing software to buy large quantities of goods for the purpose of retail resale
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the use of automated purchasing software to buy large quantities of goods for the purpose of retail resale of such goods.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that the failure to report a release of hazardous substances is a class A misdemeanor
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that the failure to report a release of hazardous substances is a class A misdemeanor and any such subsequent violation shall be a class E felony.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and findings thereon
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and the arbitrator's findings of fact and conclusions of law.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires a public hearing prior to procurements valued over one hundred thousand dollars are made overseas by public authorities
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires a public hearing before procurements valued over one hundred thousand dollars are made overseas by public authorities.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to exemptions from sales and use tax for books, candy, pictures, posters, trinkets, or any item containing a logo, collectable or seasonal item sold at a book fair or program.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to contract with a certified public accounting firm for the conducting of an independent forensic audit of such authority.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to special powers of the metropolitan transportation authority
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to special powers of the authority; allows for paratransit eligible individuals who are at least eighty years old, to be required only to present correspondence from a licensed physician, dated within the preceding thirty days, indicating that the paratransit service is still necessary for the individual to make a single application for paratransit services; once approved, such individuals shall be exempt from all certification requirements.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that residential real property which sustained 50% or greater damage in Hurricane Sandy, and is rebuilt shall be assessed at its pre-Sandy market value
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that residential real property which sustained 50% or greater damage in Hurricane Sandy, and is rebuilt shall be assessed at its pre-Sandy market value.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits monitoring of gas and electric meters any more frequently than on a monthly or billing cycle basis
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the monitoring, collection, recording or storing of data from gas and electric meters any more frequently than on a monthly or billing cycle basis, unless the express written consent of the consumer has been provided; and requires the consent of the property owner for entry upon residential property.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to expanding the eligibility period for indigent legal service attorneys
all_lanza_bills.summary: Expands the eligibility period for indigent legal service attorneys to receive certain loan forgiveness.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to increasing loan forgiveness for attorneys performing legal services for indigent clients
all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases loan reimbursement for certain attorneys who work in legal services with indigent clients from $3,400 to $5,500.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes the New York city water board to grant a 10 percent discount on NYC water bills to senior citizens and veterans.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Exempts certain officers of the department of correction and the department of sanitation of the city of New York from training requirements for security guards; designates correction officers of New York city as peace officers.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to appointments to the water board of the city of New York.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for a personal income tax deduction for school supplies paid for out-of-pocket by K-12 teachers in public and nonpublic schools, up to $500 per year.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to develop guidelines for transportation of students on field trips.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the department of health to assign at least 1 narcotics investigator to each county in a city having a population of one million or more.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to electronic citation fees
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to electronic citation fees or the process of transmitting traffic, misdemeanor, municipal ordinance, conservation, or other citations and law enforcement data via electronic means to a county clerk.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Exempts institutions of higher education from the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Elevates promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child and promoting a sexual performance by a child to be class B felonies; prohibits pleading to a lesser offense after indictment for either such offense.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to creating the multi-disciplinary team demonstration program for complex cases of adult abuse, neglect, or financial exploitation.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to segregated confinement; prohibits segregated confinement for certain persons.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the enforcement of provisions relating to carriers of household goods by motor vehicle; authorizes the attorney general to seek an injunction to enjoin and restrain the continuance or threat of certain violations by such carriers.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to price gouging
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to price gouging; defines unconscionably excessive price for the purposes of prohibiting price gouging during abnormal disruption of the market.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires investigation of school district personnel involved with the care, custody or supervision of a child
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires pre-employment investigation of school district personnel to determine criminal history or the presence of controlled substances or communicable diseases; requires submission to fingerprinting and other tests.

all_lanza_bills.title: Increases number of supreme court justices in the thirteenth judicial district to ten and in the second judicial district to fifty-two
all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases the number of supreme court justices in the thirteenth judicial district to ten and in the second judicial district to fifty-two.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires applicants for the renewal of a driver's license to prove they have acceptable vision to operate a motor vehicle
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires applicants for the renewal of a driver's license to prove they have acceptable vision to operate a motor vehicle.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have surveillance cameras in the common areas of their residential facilities
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have surveillance cameras in the common areas of their residential facilities.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to sanctions for driving while ability impaired while holding a conditional license
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to sanctions for driving while ability impaired while holding a conditional license.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that certain sex offenders who are released on parole or sentenced to probation may not enter public, association or free libraries
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that certain sex offenders who are released on parole may not enter public, association or free libraries.

REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the penalty for unlawfully fleeing a uniformed police officer of the New York city taxi and limousine commission
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the penalty for unlawfully fleeing a uniformed police officer of the New York city taxi and limousine commission.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires utilities to charge not-for-profit organized sports programs for youth residential rates
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires gas and electric corporations to charge not-for-profit organized sports programs for youth residential rates for utilities.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to enhanced penalties for aggravated cruelty to animals
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to enhanced penalties for aggravated cruelty to animals.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the criminal use of a dangerous instrument on school grounds during the commission of a felony
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the criminal use of a dangerous instrument on school grounds during the commission of a felony.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires portable electronic devices distributed after January 1, 2024 to automatically disable their texting and computer functions when the holder is operating a motor vehicle over 10 miles an hour
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires portable electronic devices distributed after January 1, 2024 to automatically disable their texting and computer functions when the holder is operating a motor vehicle over 10 miles an hour; eliminates the exemption from provisions, relating to the use of portable electronic devices in motor vehicles, granted to commercial motor vehicles, police, firefighters and emergency vehicle operators.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to penalties for committing multiple animal cruelty offenses
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to penalties for committing multiple animal cruelty offenses.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that conviction of assault on a social worker which prevents him or her from performing a lawful duty is a felony
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that conviction of assault on a social worker which prevents him or her from performing a lawful duty is a felony.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to authorizing uniformed court officers and court clerks designated as peace officers to execute arrest warrants
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to authorizing uniformed court officers and court clerks designated as peace officers to execute arrest warrants.

all_lanza_bills.title: Authorizes localities to waive citizenship requirements for certain police and firefighters in their jurisdictions
all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes localities to waive citizenship requirements for certain police and firefighters in their jurisdictions.

REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Imposes strict liability on manufacturers, owners, and operators of unmanned motor vehicles
all_lanza_bills.summary: Imposes strict liability on manufacturers, owners, and operators of unmanned motor vehicles.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs the division of criminal justice services to annually provide a list of all level 2 and 3 sex offenders residing in a county, to the residents of such county
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the division of criminal justice services to annually provide a list of all level 2 and 3 sex offenders residing in a county, to the residents of such county.

items.text: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION
REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION

all_lanza_bills.title: Makes the inability to pay child support an affirmative defense to non-support of child offenses, rather than an element of such offenses
all_lanza_bills.summary: Makes the inability to pay child support an affirmative defense to non-support of child offenses, rather than an element of such offenses.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the class D felony of criminal street gang recruitment on school grounds
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the class D felony of criminal street gang recruitment on school grounds which occurs when an individual on school grounds coerces, solicits, recruits or induces another person to join or remain a member of a criminal street gang, or conspires to do so.

all_lanza_bills.title: Expands the class A misdemeanor of public lewdness in the first degree to include the commission of public lewdness after having been convicted of a public lewdness offense in the previous 3 years
all_lanza_bills.summary: Expands the class A misdemeanor of public lewdness in the first degree to include the commission of public lewdness after having been convicted of a public lewdness offense in the previous 3 years.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the class E felony of official interference with transportation
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the class E felony of official interference with transportation.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that rape in the first degree shall be a class A-I felony
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that rape in the first degree shall be a class A-I felony and shall be punishable by life imprisonment without parole.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes an offense for fraud relating to voter registration forms
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes fraud relating to voter registration forms as a class B misdemeanor; prohibits individuals and organizations from distributing applications for voter registration forms with marked or checked party affiliation boxes.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits the diminution of health insurance benefits of certain public employee retirees
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the diminution of health insurance benefits of public employee retirees and their dependents or reducing the employer's contributions for such insurance; defines employers to include the state, municipalities, school districts, and public authorities and commissions.

items.text: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that a charitable bail organization may only post bail for a person who can prove that he or she is indigent
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that a charitable bail organization may only post bail for a person who can prove that he or she is indigent.

all_lanza_bills.title: Limits the provision of charitable bail to misdemeanor defendants who are first time offenders
all_lanza_bills.summary: Limits the provision of charitable bail to misdemeanor defendants who are first time offenders.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to meetings and proceedings of the joint commission on public ethics
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to meetings and proceedings of the joint commission on public ethics.

all_lanza_bills.title: Creates the crimes of dangerous driving in the fifth, fourth, third, second and first degrees
all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates the crimes of dangerous driving in the fifth, fourth, third, second and first degrees; imposes criminal liability on drivers who continue to operate motor vehicles in violation of the vehicle and traffic law and cause injury as a result.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for sentence of life without parole for defendants convicted of certain sex offenses against a child or mentally disabled person; repealer
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for the imposition of a sentence of life imprisonment without parole for defendants convicted of certain sex offenses against a child or mentally disabled person.

all_lanza_bills.title: Enacts the child custody reform act
all_lanza_bills.summary: Enacts the child custody reform act to provide uniform statewide standards for the litigation and mediation of child custody disputes; provides for an initial planning conference between the judge and all parties to attempt a settlement; provides for mediation unless the court finds mediation is inappropriate; requires the chief administrator of the courts to establish plans for the conduct of administration of the mediation and preparation of evaluation reports.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for random testing for anabolic steroids in athletes in public and private schools; appropriation
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for random testing for anabolic steroids in athletes in public and private schools; appropriates $1,000,000 therefor.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to visitation and custody rights involving non-U.S. citizens
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits a court from providing for visitation or custody of a minor who is a U.S. citizen to a person who resides outside the U.S. when the other party to such action is a U.S. citizen and objects to such an order.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to teen dating violence education programs
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to teen dating violence education programs; requires school districts to create policies, procedures and guidelines to implement education programs for students in kindergarten through twelfth grade to prevent, deter and address incidents of teen dating violence; defines teen dating violence.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for a 75-25 percent split in the New York city transit authority's operating surplus between the authority and the Metropolitan transportation authority
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for a 75-25 percent split in the New York city transit authority's operating surplus between the authority and the Metropolitan transit authority where previously the split was 50-50.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits the parking of a vehicle greater than sixty inches in height within fifteen feet of an intersection
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the parking of a vehicle greater than sixty inches in height within fifteen feet of an intersection.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the registration and regulation of animal breeders
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the registration and regulation of animal breeders; requires each to be licensed; creates a breeder licensing fund; exempts not-for-profit organizations.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits the use of automated purchasing software to buy large quantities of goods for the purpose of retail resale
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the use of automated purchasing software to buy large quantities of goods for the purpose of retail resale of such goods.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and findings thereon
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and the arbitrator's findings of fact and conclusions of law.

all_lanza_bills.title: Changes the official name of the Staten Island Expressway to the POW-MIA Memorial Highway
all_lanza_bills.summary: Changes the official name of the Staten Island Expressway to the "POW-MIA Memorial Highway".

COMMITTEE DISCHARGED AND COMMITTED TO RULES
REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Transfers certain lands to city of New York to be used as parklands
all_lanza_bills.summary: Transfers certain lands to the city of New York to be used as parklands.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to increasing fines for certain telemarketing violations
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to establishing a fine of $25,000 for knowingly transmitting misleading, inaccurate, or false caller identification information including but not limited to providing copied or incorrect telephone numbers and raises the maximum fine for other related violations.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to penalties for causing the death of an animal
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to penalties for causing the death of an animal; makes it a class D felony.

all_lanza_bills.title: Exempts mortgages of residential real property from taxation when property is purchased by owners receiving state or federal buyout of prior residence destroyed in hurricane Sandy
all_lanza_bills.summary: Exempts mortgages of residential real property from taxation when property is purchased by owners receiving state or federal buyout of their prior residence destroyed in hurricane Sandy.

items.text: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Increases the amount of money a public retirement system retiree may earn in a position of public service to $50,000
all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases the amount of money a public retirement system retiree may earn in a position of public service in the year 2022 and thereafter to $50,000.

items.text: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes limitations upon real property tax levies in N.Y. city
all_lanza_bills.summary: Limits, in cities having a population of one million or more, the annual increase in real property taxes.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for family members of a crime victim and interested parties to make statements to members of the parole board
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for family members of a crime victim and interested parties to make statements to members of the parole board; provides that such oral statement shall be made to the members of the state board of parole who will determine whether the defendant is released.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires a criminal history report for certain employment or volunteer applicants to the office for people with developmental disabilities
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the commissioner of the office for people with developmental disabilities to deny employment or volunteer applications based on a criminal history report for such applicant.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to contract with a certified public accounting firm for the conducting of an independent forensic audit
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to contract with a certified public accounting firm for the conducting of an independent forensic audit of such authority.

all_lanza_bills.title: Promotes understanding, awareness and enforcement of animal crimes laws; repealer
all_lanza_bills.summary: Promotes understanding, awareness and enforcement of animal crime laws.

all_lanza_bills.title: Enacts Michelle and Jordan's law relating to the penalties for a second conviction of participating in an unlawful speed contest or race
all_lanza_bills.summary: Enacts Michelle and Jordan's law relating to the penalties for a second conviction of participating in an unlawful speed contest or race.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires employees of gaming facilities to undergo human-trafficking recognition training
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires employees of gaming facilities to undergo human-trafficking recognition training which shall address the nature of human trafficking, how human trafficking is defined in law, how to identify victims of human trafficking, relief and recovery options for survivors, and social and legal services available to victims.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to waiving certain fees associated with the issuance of an enhanced driver's license
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to waiving all additional fees associated with the issuance of an enhanced driver's license if such license is required within thirty days of the issuance or reissuance of a standard driver's license.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires advertisements for certain accommodations to be submitted to designated enforcement agency
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires advertisements for certain accommodations to be submitted to the designated enforcement agency.

items.text: REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the exclusion of uncollectible taxes from the limitation on real estate taxes in New York city
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the exclusion of uncollectible taxes from the limitation on real estate taxes in New York City.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a yellow dot program under which vehicle occupants' medical information is available in the glove compartment
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a yellow dot program under which the medical and emergency contact information of the occupants, aged 55 or older, of a motor vehicle is available to emergency personnel in the glove compartment.

all_lanza_bills.title: Authorizes a parking permit system for park-and-rides in the borough of Staten Island in the city of New York
all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes a parking permit system for park-and-rides in the borough of Staten Island in the city of New York; requires residents of Staten Island to receive a permit free of charge and out-of-state residents to pay an annual fee for such permit.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to tax credits for premiums paid for long-term care insurance
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that the tax credits for long-term health care insurance shall be up to $1,000 of the premiums paid for each policy of such insurance.

items.text: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for the financing of emergency room facilities in two hospitals in each borough by the New York city health and hospitals corporation
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for the financing of emergency room facilities in two hospitals in each borough by the New York city health and hospitals corporation; requires representation on the board from each borough.

items.text: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to taxpayer relief on cell phone taxes
all_lanza_bills.summary: Removes the state sales tax on wireless telephone services; provides for a local option of imposing such taxes.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires certain public and nonpublic schools to provide transportation or reimburse costs incurred for such transportation for certain students
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires certain public and nonpublic schools to provide transportation or reimburse costs incurred for such transportation for certain students residing in an area containing at least three hundred students within a one-mile radius.

all_lanza_bills.title: Creates a homeowners' bill of rights to inform consumers with regard to insuring against catastrophic loss
all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates a homeowners' bill of rights; directs the superintendent of financial services to issue a consumer guide on insuring against catastrophic losses.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes September fourth as "Mother Teresa Remembrance Day"
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes September fourth as "Mother Teresa Remembrance Day".

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to eligibility requirements to run for the office of president of the United States
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to eligibility requirements to run for the office of president of the United States; requires upon declaration of intention to run for the office of president of the United States, an individual who is currently holding office at the state or local level must thereafter resign such state or local office.

all_lanza_bills.title: Expands eligibility for the disabled homeowners' exemption to certain surviving spouses
all_lanza_bills.summary: Expands eligibility for the disabled homeowners' exemption to certain surviving spouses; provides that if a person is eligible for the exemption and predeceases his or her spouse, such surviving spouse shall be eligible for the exemption, provided, that all other requirements are satisfied.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires the port authority of New York to conduct a study on the alignment of the Outerbridge Crossing
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires the port authority of New York to conduct a study on the alignment of the Outerbridge Crossing in order to determine what steps would need to be taken in order to widen the bridge and increase traffic flow.

items.text: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
COMMITTEE DISCHARGED AND COMMITTED TO RULES
ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.758

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to qualifying offenses for pre-trial detention
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to qualifying offenses for pre-trial detention; removes the exception for controlled substances offenses for class A felonies.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the crime of feticide
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the crime of feticide or the intentional killing of an unborn child at any stage of gestation; makes such crime a class A felony.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires a mental health medical professional to examine inmates in solitary confinement
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires a mental health medical professional to examine inmates in solitary confinement when such inmate is in such confinement for a period in excess of twenty-four hours.
