REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION

all_lanza_bills.title: Clarifies extension of uniform land use review procedures to not-for-profit entities
all_lanza_bills.summary: Clarifies the extension of uniform land use review procedures to any not-for-profit organization or corporation proposing to provide shelters to the homeless irrespective of any declaration of an emergency or a finding of need for immediate action.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes distinctive "POW-MIA" license plates and establishes the "POW-MIA awareness fund"
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes distinctive "POW-MIA" license plates; establishes the "POW-MIA awareness fund" to fund POW-MIA public education and awareness campaigns and veteran services by Rolling Thunder New York chapters and upon approval by the state director of veterans' services.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes distinctive "Alzheimer's Awareness" license plates and provides that the funding for such be deposited in the Alzheimer's disease assistance fund
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to establishing distinctive "Alzheimer's Awareness" license plates; provides that the funding for such be deposited in the "Alzheimer's disease assistance fund".

items.text: COMMITTEE DISCHARGED AND COMMITTED TO RULES
COMMITTEE DISCHARGED AND COMMITTED TO RULES

all_lanza_bills.title: Permits prescription refills to be filled fifteen days prior to their refill date during a state disaster emergency
all_lanza_bills.summary: Permits prescription refills to be filled fifteen days prior to their refill date upon the declaration of a state disaster emergency; excludes controlled substances.

all_lanza_bills.title: Enhances the penalties for crimes committed during a riot
all_lanza_bills.summary: Enhances the penalties for crimes committed during a riot.

all_lanza_bills.title: Authorizes cities to request that railroad corporations perform railroad crossing, bridge and right of ways maintenance
all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes cities to request that railroad corporations perform railroad crossing, bridge and right of ways maintenance and to perform such maintenance if the corporation fails to do so.

all_lanza_bills.title: Extends, until December 31, 2022, the authorization of residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds
all_lanza_bills.summary: Extends, from December 31, 2021 to December 31, 2022, the expiration of the authorization granted to residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds from their property.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes strict liability for injuries caused by required immunizations
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes a claim for strictly liable against the state for any injury caused by the administration of an immunization which is mandated by a state law; gives the court of claims the power and jurisdiction to hear such a claim.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires the commissioner of health to establish and publish a list of generic drug products; repealer
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires the commissioner of health to establish and publish a list of generic drug products.

all_lanza_bills.title: Modifies the membership of the metropolitan transportation authority
all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases the membership of the metropolitan transportation authority from sixteen to seventeen members; provides for the appointment for one member from each of New York City's boroughs on the written recommendation of the mayor of New York City.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to aggravated cruelty to animals
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to penalties for aggravated cruelty to animals.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the segregated confinement of pregnant inmates

all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires employees of gaming facilities to undergo human-trafficking recognition training which shall address the nature of human trafficking, how human trafficking is defined in law, how to identify victims of human trafficking, relief and recovery options for survivors, and social and legal services available to victims.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to waiving certain fees associated with the issuance of an enhanced driver's license
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to waiving all additional fees associated with the issuance of an enhanced driver's license if such license is required within thirty days of the issuance or reissuance of a standard driver's license.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires advertisements for certain accommodations to be submitted to designated enforcement agency
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires advertisements for certain accommodations to be submitted to the designated enforcement agency.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the exclusion of uncollectible taxes from the limitation on real estate taxes in New York City.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a yellow dot program under which vehicle occupants' medical information is available in the glove compartment
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a yellow dot program under which the medical and emergency contact information of the occupants, aged 55 or older, of a motor vehicle is available to emergency personnel in the glove compartment.

all_lanza_bills.title: Authorizes a parking permit system for park-and-rides in the borough of Staten Island in the city of New York
all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes a parking permit system for park-and-rides in the borough of Staten Island in the city of New York; requires residents of Staten Island to receive a permit free of charge and out-of-state residents to pay an annual fee for such permit.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to tax credits for premiums paid for long-term care insurance
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that the tax credits for long-term health care insurance shall be up to $1,000 of the premiums paid for each policy of such insurance.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for the financing of emergency room facilities in two hospitals in each borough by the New York city health and hospitals corporation; requires representation on the board from each borough.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to taxpayer relief on cell phone taxes
all_lanza_bills.summary: Removes the state sales tax on wireless telephone services; provides for a local option of imposing such taxes.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires certain public and nonpublic schools to provide transportation or reimburse costs incurred for such transportation for certain students
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires certain public and nonpublic schools to provide transportation or reimburse costs incurred for such transportation for certain students residing in an area containing at least three hundred students within a one-mile radius.

all_lanza_bills.title: Creates a homeowners' bill of rights to inform consumers with regard to insuring against catastrophic loss
all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates a homeowners' bill of rights; directs the superintendent of financial services to issue a consumer guide on insuring against catastrophic losses.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes September fourth as "Mother Teresa Remembrance Day"
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes September fourth as "Mother Teresa Remembrance Day".

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to eligibility requirements to run for the office of president of the United States
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to eligibility requirements to run for the office of president of the United States; requires upon declaration of intention to run for the office of president of the United States, an individual who is currently holding office at the state or local level must thereafter resign such state or local office.

all_lanza_bills.title: Expands eligibility for the disabled homeowners' exemption to certain surviving spouses
all_lanza_bills.summary: Expands eligibility for the disabled homeowners' exemption to certain surviving spouses; provides that if a person is eligible for the exemption and predeceases his or her spouse, such surviving spouse shall be eligible for the exemption, provided, that all other requirements are satisfied.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires the port authority of New York to conduct a study on the alignment of the Outerbridge Crossing
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires the port authority of New York to conduct a study on the alignment of the Outerbridge Crossing in order to determine what steps would need to be taken in order to widen the bridge and increase traffic flow.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to qualifying offenses for pre-trial detention; removes the exception for controlled substances offenses for class A felonies.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the crime of feticide or the intentional killing of an unborn child at any stage of gestation; makes such crime a class A felony.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires a mental health medical professional to examine inmates in solitary confinement when such inmate is in such confinement for a period in excess of twenty-four hours.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to establishing distinctive "Alzheimer's Awareness" license plates; provides that the funding for such be deposited in the "Alzheimer's disease assistance fund".

all_lanza_bills.summary: Enhances the penalties for crimes committed during a riot.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes cities to request that railroad corporations perform railroad crossing, bridge and right of ways maintenance and to perform such maintenance if the corporation fails to do so.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Extends, from December 31, 2021 to December 31, 2022, the expiration of the authorization granted to residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds from their property.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes a claim for strictly liable against the state for any injury caused by the administration of an immunization which is mandated by a state law; gives the court of claims the power and jurisdiction to hear such a claim.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires the commissioner of health to establish and publish a list of generic drug products.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases the membership of the metropolitan transportation authority from sixteen to seventeen members; provides for the appointment for one member from each of New York City's boroughs on the written recommendation of the mayor of New York City.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to penalties for aggravated cruelty to animals.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes insurers to allow the insured to take and submit photographs of their automobile for purposes of the issuance or renewal of a policy of automobile physical damage insurance.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that an automobile insurer may waive the inspection of a private passenger automobile prior to providing physical damage coverage.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to appointments to the water board of the city of New York.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Allows for distinctive plates to be issued for members of the New York city fire riders motorcycle club.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the MTA to rename the Eltingville transit center the Iraq War and Afghanistan War Veterans' Memorial Transit Center; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to granting certain court reporters peace officer status.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the class C felony offense of assault on a school employee for the intentional causing of physical injury to a school employee while upon school grounds.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for immediate notification to a complainant, in the manner specified by the complainant, of the service of an ex parte order of protection.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates a new class D violent felony offense of endangering the welfare of a child in the first degree; converts the current offense of endangering the welfare of a child to a second degree crime.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires a course of instruction on the provisions of the federalist papers and the United States constitution to be provided to high school students.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the department of health to assign at least 1 narcotics investigator to each county in a city having a population of one million or more.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have surveillance cameras in the common areas of their residential facilities.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that conviction of assault on a social worker which prevents him or her from performing a lawful duty is a felony.

all_lanza_bills.title: Enacts the child custody reform act
all_lanza_bills.summary: Enacts the child custody reform act to provide uniform statewide standards for the litigation and mediation of child custody disputes; provides for an initial planning conference between the judge and all parties to attempt a settlement; provides for mediation unless the court finds mediation is inappropriate; requires the chief administrator of the courts to establish plans for the conduct of administration of the mediation and preparation of evaluation reports.

all_lanza_bills.title: Increases the amount of money a public retirement system retiree may earn in a position of public service to $50,000
all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases the amount of money a public retirement system retiree may earn in a position of public service in the year 2024 and thereafter to $50,000.

items.text: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires the commissioner of health to establish and publish a list of generic drug products; repealer
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires the commissioner of health to establish and publish a list of generic drug products.

all_lanza_bills.title: Authorizes cities to request that railroad corporations perform railroad crossing, bridge and right of ways maintenance
all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes cities to request that railroad corporations perform railroad crossing, bridge and right of ways maintenance and to perform such maintenance if the corporation fails to do so.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires employees of gaming facilities to undergo human-trafficking recognition training
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires employees of gaming facilities to undergo human-trafficking recognition training which shall address the nature of human trafficking, how human trafficking is defined in law, how to identify victims of human trafficking, relief and recovery options for survivors, and social and legal services available to victims.

all_lanza_bills.title: Creates a homeowners' bill of rights to inform consumers with regard to insuring against catastrophic loss
all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates a homeowners' bill of rights; directs the superintendent of financial services to issue a consumer guide on insuring against catastrophic losses.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a yellow dot program under which vehicle occupants' medical information is available in the glove compartment
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a yellow dot program under which the medical and emergency contact information of the occupants, aged 55 or older, of a motor vehicle is available to emergency personnel in the glove compartment.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the crime of feticide
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the crime of feticide or the intentional killing of an unborn child at any stage of gestation; makes such crime a class A felony.

all_lanza_bills.title: Changes the official name of the Staten Island Expressway to the POW-MIA Memorial Highway
all_lanza_bills.summary: Changes the official name of the Staten Island Expressway to the "POW-MIA Memorial Highway".

items.text: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for family members of a crime victim and interested parties to make statements to members of the parole board
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for family members of a crime victim and interested parties to make statements to members of the parole board; provides that such oral statement shall be made to the members of the state board of parole who will determine whether the defendant is released.

all_lanza_bills.title: Transfers certain lands to city of New York to be used as parklands
all_lanza_bills.summary: Transfers certain lands to the city of New York to be used as parklands.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to contract with a certified public accounting firm for the conducting of an independent forensic audit
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to contract with a certified public accounting firm for the conducting of an independent forensic audit of such authority.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits the diminution of health insurance benefits of certain public employee retirees
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the diminution of health insurance benefits of public employee retirees and their dependents or reducing the employer's contributions for such insurance; defines employers to include the state, municipalities, school districts, and public authorities and commissions.

items.text: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
AMEND AND RECOMMIT TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for the seizure and forfeiture of vehicles, vessels and aircraft used in counterfeit goods
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for the seizure and forfeiture of vehicles, vessels and aircraft used in counterfeit goods; establishes this shall not apply to vehicles, vessels, or aircrafts that are used by any person as a common carrier in the transaction of business as such common carrier.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes September fourth as "Mother Teresa Remembrance Day"
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes September fourth as "Mother Teresa Remembrance Day".

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to eligibility requirements to run for the office of president of the United States
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to eligibility requirements to run for the office of president of the United States; requires upon declaration of intention to run for the office of president of the United States, an individual who is currently holding office at the state or local level must thereafter resign such state or local office.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires a criminal history report for certain employment or volunteer applicants to the office for people with developmental disabilities
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the commissioner of the office for people with developmental disabilities to deny employment or volunteer applications based on a criminal history report for such applicant.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the exclusion of uncollectible taxes from the limitation on real estate taxes in New York city
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the exclusion of uncollectible taxes from the limitation on real estate taxes in New York City.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for the financing of emergency room facilities in two hospitals in each borough by the New York city health and hospitals corporation
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for the financing of emergency room facilities in two hospitals in each borough by the New York city health and hospitals corporation; requires representation on the board from each borough.

items.text: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Enhances the penalties for crimes committed during a riot
all_lanza_bills.summary: Enhances the penalties for crimes committed during a riot.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to waiving certain fees associated with the issuance of an enhanced driver's license
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to waiving all additional fees associated with the issuance of an enhanced driver's license if such license is required within thirty days of the issuance or reissuance of a standard driver's license.

all_lanza_bills.title: Modifies the membership of the metropolitan transportation authority
all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases the membership of the metropolitan transportation authority from sixteen to seventeen members; provides for the appointment for one member from each of New York City's boroughs on the written recommendation of the mayor of New York City.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to increasing fines for certain telemarketing violations
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to establishing a fine of $25,000 for knowingly transmitting misleading, inaccurate, or false caller identification information including but not limited to providing copied or incorrect telephone numbers; raises the maximum fine for other related violations.

all_lanza_bills.title: Exempts mortgages of residential real property from taxation when property is purchased by owners receiving state or federal buyout of prior residence destroyed in hurricane Sandy
all_lanza_bills.summary: Exempts mortgages of residential real property from taxation when property is purchased by owners receiving state or federal buyout of their prior residence destroyed in hurricane Sandy.

items.text: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires advertisements for certain accommodations to be submitted to designated enforcement agency
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires advertisements for certain accommodations to be submitted to the designated enforcement agency.

items.text: REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT

all_lanza_bills.title: Enacts Michelle and Jordan's law relating to the penalties for a second conviction of participating in an unlawful speed contest or race
all_lanza_bills.summary: Enacts Michelle and Jordan's law relating to the penalties for a second conviction of participating in an unlawful speed contest or race.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to qualifying offenses for pre-trial detention
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to qualifying offenses for pre-trial detention; removes the exception for controlled substances offenses for class A felonies.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to establishing a crisis intervention team program
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to establishing a crisis intervention demonstration program.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes distinctive "Alzheimer's Awareness" license plates and provides that the funding for such be deposited in the Alzheimer's disease assistance fund
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to establishing distinctive "Alzheimer's Awareness" license plates; provides that the funding for such be deposited in the "Alzheimer's disease assistance fund".

items.text: COMMITTEE DISCHARGED AND COMMITTED TO RULES

all_lanza_bills.title: Creates the teen driver safety commission
all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates the teen driver safety commission consisting of 12 members; requires the commission to study, examine and review the issue of teen driver safety; requires the commission to report its findings, conclusions and recommendations.

all_lanza_bills.title: Permits prescription refills to be filled fifteen days prior to their refill date during a state disaster emergency
all_lanza_bills.summary: Permits prescription refills to be filled fifteen days prior to their refill date upon the declaration of a state disaster emergency; excludes controlled substances.

all_lanza_bills.title: Elevates all computer tampering offenses by one degree in severity
all_lanza_bills.summary: Elevates all computer tampering offenses by one degree in severity.

all_lanza_bills.title: Defines the terms "impaired" and "intoxication" for the purposes of the vehicle and traffic law
all_lanza_bills.summary: Defines the terms "impaired" and "intoxication" for the purposes of the vehicle and traffic law.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs board of standards and appeals in city of New York to mail a copy of each application for a variance to the city and state legislators for the affected land
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the board of standards and appeals and the city planning commission in the city of New York to mail a copy of each application for and appeal of a variance to the city council member, borough president and state legislators for the affected land.

all_lanza_bills.title: Promotes understanding, awareness and enforcement of animal crimes laws; repealer
all_lanza_bills.summary: Promotes understanding, awareness and enforcement of animal crime laws.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the class E felony of dissemination of false missing child information
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the class E felony of dissemination of false missing child information.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires certain public and nonpublic schools to provide transportation or reimburse costs incurred for such transportation for certain students
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires certain public and nonpublic schools to provide transportation or reimburse costs incurred for such transportation for certain students residing in an area containing at least three hundred students within a one-mile radius.

all_lanza_bills.title: Creates the crime of falsely accusing someone of a crime
all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates the crime of falsely accusing someone of a crime.

all_lanza_bills.title: Expands eligibility for the disabled homeowners' exemption to certain surviving spouses
all_lanza_bills.summary: Expands eligibility for the disabled homeowners' exemption to certain surviving spouses; provides that if a person is eligible for the exemption and predeceases his or her spouse, such surviving spouse shall be eligible for the exemption, provided, that all other requirements are satisfied.

all_lanza_bills.title: Clarifies extension of uniform land use review procedures to not-for-profit entities
all_lanza_bills.summary: Clarifies the extension of uniform land use review procedures to any not-for-profit organization or corporation proposing to provide shelters to the homeless irrespective of any declaration of an emergency or a finding of need for immediate action.

all_lanza_bills.title: Authorizes a parking permit system for park-and-rides in the borough of Staten Island in the city of New York
all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes a parking permit system for park-and-rides in the borough of Staten Island in the city of New York; requires residents of Staten Island to receive a permit free of charge and out-of-state residents to pay an annual fee for such permit.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires a mental health medical professional to examine incarcerated individuals in solitary confinement
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires a mental health medical professional to examine incarcerated individuals in solitary confinement when such incarcerated individual is in such confinement for a period in excess of twenty-four hours.

items.text: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION
REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires website providing sex offender registry information to be searchable by the zip code of a registrant's employment
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires websites providing sex offender registry information to be searchable by the zip code of a registrant's employment.

items.text: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION
REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the crime of larceny of a controlled substance
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the crime of larceny of a controlled substance making it an A-II felony to steal more than 25 dosage units of a schedule II, III, IV, or V controlled substance from a pharmacy.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs the board of standards and appeals in the city of New York to mail a copy of each application for a variance to property owners within 1 mile
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the board of standards and appeals in the city of New York to mail a copy of each application for a variance to property owners within 1 mile of the affected property.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to recreational therapy
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to defining the practice of recreation therapy; establishes procedures for licensure of recreation therapists and requirements for continuing education for recreation therapists.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes strict liability for injuries caused by required immunizations
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes a claim for strict liability against the state for any injury caused by the administration of an immunization which is mandated by a state law; gives the court of claims the power and jurisdiction to hear such a claim.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the blue ribbon commission on bail
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes a temporary blue ribbon commission to study bail and the bail industry; requires an interim report be issued one year after the effective date of this act including the commission's findings, conclusions and recommendations, and a final report of the same shall be issued two years after the effective date of this act including legislative proposals as it deems necessary to implement such recommendations.

all_lanza_bills.title: Enacts "Cesar's law" to require the retaking of parolees who abscond from the supervision of the state board of parole
all_lanza_bills.summary: Enacts "Cesar's law" to require the retaking of parolees who abscond from the supervision of the state board of parole.

items.text: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION
REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides certain requirements for health care proxies and death certificates
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides certain requirements for health care proxies and death certificates.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires persons against whom an order of protection is issued to wear an electronic monitoring device
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires persons against whom an order of protection is issued to wear an electronic monitoring device; prohibits the tampering with such a device and violation of such prohibition constitutes a class E felony.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the distribution of educational materials regarding the misuse of and addiction to prescription drugs in counties with the most prevalent abuse of prescription opioids
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the distribution of educational materials regarding the misuse of and addiction to prescription drugs in counties with the most prevalent abuse of prescription opioids.

items.text: REFERRED TO ALCOHOLISM AND SUBSTANCE USE DISORDERS
REFERRED TO ALCOHOLISM AND SUBSTANCE USE DISORDERS
REFERRED TO ALCOHOLISM AND DRUG ABUSE

all_lanza_bills.title: Limits who may bring a private right of action for identifying a victim of a sex offense; only brought by the victim where the information has not otherwise been publicly disclosed
all_lanza_bills.summary: Limits who may bring a private right of action for identifying a victim of a sex offense; only brought by the victim where the information has not otherwise been publicly disclosed.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to taxpayer relief on cell phone taxes
all_lanza_bills.summary: Removes the state sales tax on wireless telephone services; provides for a local option of imposing such taxes.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for revocation of probation where a person is convicted of a new offense while such person is under probation supervision for a felony offense
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for revocation of probation where a person is convicted of a felony or an offense in another jurisdiction which if committed in this state would constitute a felony, while the defendant is under probation supervision for a felony offense.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes distinctive "POW-MIA" license plates and establishes the "POW-MIA awareness fund"
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes distinctive "POW-MIA" license plates; establishes the "POW-MIA awareness fund" to fund POW-MIA public education and awareness campaigns and veteran services by Rolling Thunder New York chapters and upon approval by the state director of veterans' services.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits the siting and construction of battery energy storage systems and related facilities, systems, infrastructure, and substations of any scale and possessing any storage capacity on Staten Island
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the siting and construction of battery energy storage systems and related facilities, systems, infrastructure, and substations of any scale and possessing any storage capacity on Staten Island.

all_lanza_bills.title: Congratulating Anthony Aquaro upon the occasion of his 102nd Birthday
Expands aggravated cruelty to animals to include all animals
all_lanza_bills.summary: Expands aggravated cruelty to animals to include all animals.

all_lanza_bills.title: Amends the general business law, insurance law, and public health law regarding preneed insurance premiums
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to preneed insurance premiums.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to expanding the eligibility period for indigent legal service attorneys
all_lanza_bills.summary: Expands the eligibility period for indigent legal service attorneys to receive certain loan forgiveness.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides an exemption for lifeguard services
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides an exemption from sales and compensating use taxes for lifeguard services provided by a qualified lifeguard or aquatic supervisory staff.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that the fines for traffic infractions and traffic misdemeanors committed in a school traffic control zone are doubled
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that the fines for traffic infractions and traffic misdemeanors committed in a school traffic control zone are doubled; requires such zones to be marked by a traffic light or stop sign.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to real property tax exemptions for disabled veterans
all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases, at local option, real property tax exemptions for combat veterans who are 100% permanently disabled.

items.text: REFERRED TO VETERANS, HOMELAND SECURITY AND MILITARY AFFAIRS
REFERRED TO VETERANS, HOMELAND SECURITY AND MILITARY AFFAIRS

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to arson in the first degree
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes a person is guilty of arson in the first degree when he intentionally damages a building or motor vehicle by causing an explosion or a fire and when such explosion or fire is accelerated by use of ignitable liquid or flammable gas.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to collective employment negotiations, notice of the issuance of debt and capital plans and projects of the port authority of New York and New Jersey
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to collective employment negotiations, notice of the issuance of debt and capital plans and projects of the port authority of New York and New Jersey.

items.text: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits monitoring of gas and electric meters any more frequently than on a monthly or billing cycle basis
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the monitoring, collection, recording or storing of data from gas and electric meters any more frequently than on a monthly or billing cycle basis, unless the express written consent of the consumer has been provided; requires the consent of the property owner for entry upon residential property.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to certain contracts regarding bus drivers and bus drivers' assistants
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to certain contracts regarding bus drivers and bus drivers' assistants.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires a public hearing prior to procurements valued over one hundred thousand dollars are made overseas by public authorities
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires a public hearing before procurements valued over one hundred thousand dollars are made overseas by public authorities.

items.text: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires heart examinations for public school students
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires heart examinations for public school students and a statement on whether the student is fit to participate in physical education or other athletic activities.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits municipalities from transferring primary investigating authority of vehicle collisions that result in serious injury or death to a non-law enforcement agency
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits municipalities from transferring primary investigating authority of vehicle collisions that result in serious injury or death from the police to a non-law enforcement agency.

all_lanza_bills.title: Includes the Sandy Ground community in the education curriculum
all_lanza_bills.summary: Includes the Sandy Ground community, the oldest continuously inhabited free black settlement in the United States, in the education curriculum.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for the continuation of express bus service to the south shore of Staten Island
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for the continuation of express bus service to the south shore of Staten Island.

items.text: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the offenses of phishing in the third degree, phishing in the second degree and phishing in the first degree; and relates to the time in which a prosecution of such offenses must be commenced
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the offenses of phishing in the third degree, phishing in the second degree and phishing in the first degree; relates to the time in which prosecution of such offenses must be commenced.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the procedure followed by the justice center when responding to certain reportable incidents
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires the justice center to establish procedures for when to report incidents which include suspicious and unexplained injuries including broken bones, hematomas, open wounds beyond minor first aid, black eyes, swollen noses, extreme and questionable bruising, choke marks, burns, individuals found unresponsive and all deaths to a 9-1-1 operator.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to increasing loan forgiveness for attorneys performing legal services for indigent clients
all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases loan reimbursement for certain attorneys who work in legal services with indigent clients from $3,400 to $5,500.

all_lanza_bills.title: Authorizes emergency medical care personnel to provide basic first aid to dogs and cats
all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes emergency medical care personnel to provide basic first aid to dogs and cats.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to expediting actions involving insurance claims for damages resulting from a state disaster emergency
all_lanza_bills.summary: Expedites actions involving insurance claims for damages resulting from a state disaster emergency; sets time frames.

all_lanza_bills.title: Authorizes the removal from a teacher's classroom of a violent pupil
all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes the removal from a teacher's classroom of a violent pupil; establishes that such pupil shall only return to the classroom with the consent of the teacher if the pupil committed an act of violence against a teacher.

all_lanza_bills.title: Redesignates certain sex, prostitution, obscenity and sexual performance offenses committed against a child as class A-I felonies with a sentence of life imprisonment without parole
all_lanza_bills.summary: Redesignates certain sex, prostitution, obscenity and sexual performance offenses committed against a child as class A-I felonies with a sentence of life imprisonment without parole.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the John J. Marchi government studies scholarship program for certain CUNY students
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the John J. Marchi government studies scholarship program for CUNY students enrolled in government or government related studies.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes class A-I felony of criminal use of a firearm for possessing a deadly weapon or displaying a gun during the commission of a class A or violent felony; repealer
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the class A-I felony of criminal use of a firearm for possessing a deadly weapon or displaying what appears to be or is a rifle, pistol, revolver, shotgun, machine gun or other firearm during the commission of a class A or violent felony; repeals the offenses of criminal use of a firearm in the first and second degrees.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits expenditure of state, local or public authority moneys relating to federal terrorism trials in the state of New York
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the expenditure of state, local and public authority moneys relating to any civilian criminal trial of enemy combatants for acts of terrorism in any federal court in the state of New York.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires certain procedures for charter school students facing suspension
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires certain procedures for charter school students facing suspension; makes such procedures consistent with other schools.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits sex offenders from operating automobiles participating in mobile application based transportation networks or being employed by such transportation networks
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits sex offenders from operating automobiles participating in mobile application based transportation networks or being employed by such transportation networks.

all_lanza_bills.title: Exempts certain paratransit eligible individuals from recertification requirements
all_lanza_bills.summary: Allows for paratransit eligible for paratransit eligible individuals who are at least eighty years old, to be required only to present correspondence from a licensed physician, dated within the preceding thirty days, indicating that the paratransit service is still necessary for the individual to make a single application for paratransit services; provides that once approved, such individuals shall be exempt from all certification requirements.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to exemptions from sales and use tax for books, candy, pictures, posters, trinkets, or any item containing a logo, collectable or seasonal item sold at a book fair or program
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to exemptions from sales and use tax for books, candy, pictures, posters, trinkets, or any item containing a logo, collectable or seasonal item sold at a book fair or program.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for the registration and regulation of pet groomers; establishes standards of care, training and testing
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for the registration and regulation of pet groomers; establishes standards of care, training and testing; provides such applicant must be at least eighteen years of age.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that when the governor declares a weather related state of emergency in a city having a population of one million or more, all public and private elementary and secondary schools shall be closed
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that when the governor declares a weather related state of emergency in a city having a population of one million or more, all public and private elementary and secondary schools shall be closed and remain closed until such emergency is terminated.

items.text: REFERRED TO VETERANS, HOMELAND SECURITY AND MILITARY AFFAIRS
REFERRED TO VETERANS, HOMELAND SECURITY AND MILITARY AFFAIRS

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to hate crimes and bail eligibility
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to hate crimes, as defined in article four hundred eighty-five of the penal law, and bail eligibility.

all_lanza_bills.title: Permits the commissioner of education to include graduate programs as programs eligible for approval under the state tuition assistance program
all_lanza_bills.summary: Permits the commissioner of education to include graduate programs as programs eligible for approval under the state tuition assistance program.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to license fees per barrel of petroleum ship through the state for use outside the state
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to license fees per barrel of petroleum shipped through the state for use outside the state by facilities within 1 mile of a similar facility in another state.

all_lanza_bills.title: Limits the substitution of abuse-deterrent analgesic opioid drug products for analgesic opioids lacking such technology
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for patient access to FDA approved abuse-deterrent technology to help combat opioid abuse.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for a tax credit for a certain amount of money expended on the care of a qualifying disabled child
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for a tax credit for a certain amount of money expended on the care of a qualifying disabled child.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to confidentiality of records in proceedings to vacate convictions for offenses resulting from sex trafficking, labor trafficking and compelling prostitution
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for confidentiality of records in proceedings to vacate convictions for offenses resulting from sex trafficking, labor trafficking and compelling prostitution.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs the commissioner of health to promulgate rules and regulations to reduce the diversion of addiction medications
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the commissioner of the department of health to promulgate rules and regulations promoting recovery from opioid misuse and reducing diversion of addiction medicines.

items.text: REFERRED TO ALCOHOLISM AND SUBSTANCE USE DISORDERS
REFERRED TO ALCOHOLISM AND SUBSTANCE USE DISORDERS

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires hospital and emergency room physicians to notify a patient's prescriber that such patient is being treated for a controlled substance overdose
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires hospital and emergency room physicians to consult the prescription monitoring program registry and to notify a patient's prescriber that such patient is being treated for a controlled substance overdose.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the class C felony of assault of a patient in a mental health or developmental disability facility
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the class C felony of assault of a patient in a mental health or developmental disability facility, for the intentional causation of physical injury to a patient residing in a facility operated, licensed or certified by the office of mental health or the office for people with developmental disabilities.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to health care and wellness education and outreach programs for preventing sudden cardiac arrest among student athletes
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to health care and wellness education and outreach programs for preventing sudden cardiac arrest among student athletes including recommending evidenced-based best practices for health certificates required pursuant to the education law, screening exams required for participation in interscholastic athletics, and information for students and their parents and guardians regarding sudden cardiac arrest.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the application of special rebates and discounts to certain eligible energy users
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the application of special rebates and discounts to certain eligible energy users that conduct a manufacturing activity within the city which produces new goods primarily from waste paper or other recyclables collected from residential sources in the city.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the unlawful possession of a patient record
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the unlawful possession of a patient record; makes such offense a class A misdemeanor.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs that the flag to be flown at half-staff to commemorate the death of members of the United States armed forces who were residents of New York and were killed in action
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs that the flag be flown at half-staff to commemorate the death of members of the United States armed forces who were residents of New York and were killed in action.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to requiring the commissioner of the department of civil service to prepare a report on certain civil service titles
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to requiring the commissioner of the department of civil service to prepare a report on civil service titles which require an appointee to possess a license and current registration as a mental health practitioner in one or more professions under article 163 of the education law.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires port authority to acquire economic impact statement prior to increasing bridge and tunnel tolls
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires the port authority of New York and New Jersey to acquire an economic impact statement by an independent contractor at least 30 days prior to increasing bridge and tunnel tolls.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the "education affordability act" and tax credit
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the "education affordability act" and tax credit; provides credits against income and corporate franchise tax for various qualified education investments including scholarships, education funds and home-based instructional materials.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs a city with a population of one million or more to reduce its real property tax levy
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs a city with a population of one million or more to reduce its real property tax levy for the 2024 fiscal year by an amount not less than the real property tax increase authorized pursuant to local law 40 of the city of New York for the year 2002.

all_lanza_bills.title: Creates an appeals process for the district attorney
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to creating an appeals process for the district attorney in the county where the crime was committed where family members of a victim or persons residing in a county where an offender committed a crime can appeal the board's decision to release the offender if the offender committed certain criminal offenses.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires persons issued a driver's license or permit to report the instance of a medically diagnosed seizure to the commissioner of motor vehicles
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires a person issued a driver's license or permit to report the instance of a medically diagnosed seizure to the commissioner of motor vehicles within sixty days of such seizure.

all_lanza_bills.title: Directs the public service commission to implement rules requiring public utility companies to remove or relocate their utility poles when necessary for road improvements
all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the public service commission to implement rules requiring public utility companies to remove or relocate their utility poles when necessary for road improvements.

all_lanza_bills.title: Allows vehicles bearing Purple Heart and disabled veteran plates to park in handicapped parking spaces
all_lanza_bills.summary: Allows vehicles bearing Purple Heart and disabled veteran plates to park in handicapped parking spaces.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that the borough of Staten Island shall also be known and designated as the "borough of parks"
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that the borough of Staten Island shall also be known and designated as the "borough of parks".

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to warning labels on certain sports and muscle creams
all_lanza_bills.summary: Enacts Arielle's Law which requires the placement of warning labels on certain sports and muscle creams.

all_lanza_bills.title: Extends the moratorium on the issuance of environmental safety certificates for facilities and routes for the transportation of liquefied natural or petroleum gas
all_lanza_bills.summary: Extends the moratorium on the issuance of certificates of environmental safety for the siting of facilities and certification of routes for the transportation of liquefied natural or petroleum gas.

all_lanza_bills.title: Extends the time period for the conveyance of lands for the establishment of the Gateway National Recreation Area
all_lanza_bills.summary: Extends the time period for the conveyance of lands for the establishment of the Gateway National Recreation Area until June 30, 2025.

all_lanza_bills.title: Extends, until December 31, 2024, the authorization of residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds
all_lanza_bills.summary: Extends, from December 31, 2023 to December 31, 2024, the expiration of the authorization granted to residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds from their property.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for the application of the veterans' real property tax exemptions in the city of New York
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for the application of veterans' real property tax exemptions in cities having a population of one million or more.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to appointments made by the governor and the senate
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that when an appointment to an office by the governor by and with the advice and consent of the senate is communicated, in the form of a written nomination of a person for the office, the senate shall wait at least thirty days to confirm or reject such nomination from the date such written nomination was received; makes related provisions.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the contents of a notice of liability issued for a speed camera violation
all_lanza_bills.summary: Permits a violation captured by a speed camera to be dismissed upon the application of the person alleged to be liable for such violation if any information that is required to be inserted in the notice of liability is omitted from such notice of liability, misdescribed or illegible.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes domestic abuse offenses, provides for special information for certain felony domestic abuse offenses and designates such offenses as family offenses
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes domestic abuse offenses for assaults upon spouses, former spouses, fellow parents of a child in common and domestic partners; provides for issuance of a special information for domestic abuse in the first degree requiring a predicate criminal conviction; designates such domestic abuse offenses as family offenses for purposes of the criminal procedure law and the family court act.

all_lanza_bills.title: Authorizes certain organizations in N.Y. city to be known as "fire patrols" under the not-for-profit corporation law
all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes certain organizations in a city of one million or more to be known as "fire patrols" under the not-for-profit corporation law; includes fire patrol vehicles as emergency vehicles under the vehicle and traffic law.

items.text: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS

all_lanza_bills.summary: Renames the Oakwood Beach wetland the Oakwood Beach-Detective Russel Timoshenko Preserve.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to references by a city school district in a city with a population of one million or more to public holidays
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to references by a city school district in a city with a population of one million or more to public holidays, specifically Columbus Day; provides that any literature or document created and/or distributed by such district do the same including school calendars.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Exempts pet food from sales and compensating use taxes.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prohibits a mandatory immunization against the novel coronavirus/COVID-19
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits a mandatory immunization against the novel coronavirus/COVID-19 for children, incapacitated persons, or students or staff of employment institutions or day care facilities; prohibits requiring people to carry or present evidence of having received the COVID-19 vaccine.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to crimes committed on metropolitan transportation authority property
all_lanza_bills.summary: Makes a crime while in or upon metropolitan transportation authority property an A-1 felony; provides sentencing guidelines for such crime.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for notification to hospital patients upon intake of reports of hospital-acquired infections
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for notification to hospital patients upon intake of reports of hospital-acquired infections.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to resisting arrest
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to resisting arrest; reclassifies resisting arrest as a class E felony not eligible for release on an appearance ticket.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to false statements in documents submitted to the department of buildings of the city of New York
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to false statements in documents submitted to the department of buildings of the city of New York.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to protecting MTA workers from harassment
all_lanza_bills.summary: Expands the definition of aggravated harassment in the second degree to include harassing any MTA worker while performing their job duties.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to prohibiting mandatory immunization against the coronavirus
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits mandatory immunization against the coronavirus; prohibits requiring immunization for attendance at school or day care, transportation, travel, entering public buildings, employment, nursing home residency or receiving government services; provides that no proof of vaccine shall be required or used; prohibits incentive for administering or receiving vaccination.

all_lanza_bills.title: Prevents municipalities from abridging the election law
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prevents municipalities from abridging the election law.

all_lanza_bills.title: Grants George Jensen an earlier starting date with the New York City Department of Sanitation
all_lanza_bills.summary: Grants George Jensen an earlier starting date with the New York City Department of Sanitation of August 1, 2021 as his current start date is November 1, 2021 due to a clerical error.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes an alternatively assessed student program
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes an alternatively assessed student program in the New York City school district which allows one student, per school, per year, to be hired as a school aid in any public school within such district.

REFERRED TO NEW YORK CITY EDUCATION

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that the tax credits for long-term health care insurance shall be up to $1,000 of the premiums paid for each policy of such insurance.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the criminal use of a dangerous instrument on school grounds during the commission of a felony.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the regulation of fifth generation (5G) telecommunications towers in cities with a population of one million or more
all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the placement of fifth generation (5G) telecommunications towers within 250 feet of a business or residence in cities with a population of one million or more without the owner's consent; requires community board approval and the completion of a city environmental quality review before the placement of any 5G tower can be approved.

all_lanza_bills.title: Increases the maximum qualifying income for the senior citizen homeowner's exemption and the disabled homeowner's exemption
all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases the maximum qualifying income for the senior citizen homeowner's exemption and the disabled homeowner's exemption to $70,000 in the city of New York.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Reclassifies court officers and court clerks of the unified court system under the definition of police officer.

all_lanza_bills.title: Authorizes insurers to allow the insured to take and submit photographs of their automobile for purposes of the issuance or renewal of a policy of automobile physical damage insurance
all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes insurers to allow the insured to take and submit photographs of their automobile for purposes of the issuance or renewal of a policy of automobile physical damage insurance.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides that an automobile insurer may waive the inspection of a private passenger automobile prior to providing physical damage coverage
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides that an automobile insurer may waive the inspection of a private passenger automobile prior to providing physical damage coverage.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to appointments to the water board of the city of New York.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes the New York city water board to grant a 10 percent discount on NYC water bills to senior citizens and veterans.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Exempts certain officers of the department of correction and the department of sanitation of the city of New York from training requirements for security guards; designates correction officers of New York city as peace officers.

all_lanza_bills.title: Increases the in-person appearance requirements for level two sex offenders
all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases the in-person appearance requirements for level two sex offenders from every three years to every year.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Prohibits the disposal of any dredged spoils containing toxic pollutants into the waters of the marine district.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the declaration of a sign as a public nuisance and its removal by order of the commissioner.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Authorizes the temporary occupancy, for compensation, of a class A multiple dwelling that is a cooperative or condominium unit under certain conditions.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases the household threshold income cap on tuition assistance from $80,000 to $100,000.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the registered weight of tow trucks
all_lanza_bills.summary: Increases, from 8,600 pounds to 10,000 pounds, the gross vehicle weight rating of vehicles engaged in commercial towing that must be registered as tow trucks.

all_lanza_bills.title: Allows for distinctive plates to be issued for members of the New York city fire riders motorcycle club
all_lanza_bills.summary: Allows for distinctive plates to be issued for members of the New York city fire riders motorcycle club.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the MTA to rename the Eltingville transit center the Iraq War and Afghanistan War Veterans' Memorial Transit Center; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

all_lanza_bills.title: Grants court reporters in the first and second departments peace officer status
all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to granting certain court reporters peace officer status.

all_lanza_bills.title: Establishes the class C felony offense of assault on a school employee
all_lanza_bills.summary: Establishes the class C felony offense of assault on a school employee for the intentional causing of physical injury to a school employee while upon school grounds.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for immediate notification to a complainant of the service of an ex parte order of protection
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for immediate notification to a complainant, in the manner specified by the complainant, of the service of an ex parte order of protection.

all_lanza_bills.title: Relates to the crime of endangering the welfare of a child
all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates a new class D violent felony offense of endangering the welfare of a child in the first degree; converts the current offense of endangering the welfare of a child to a second degree crime.

all_lanza_bills.title: Enacts the "New York city board for education policy members public responsibility act"
all_lanza_bills.summary: Enacts the "New York city board for education policy members public responsibility act" requiring a quorum of the members of the city board to attend any hearing scheduled for purposes of allowing public comment on changes to educational plans for the school district of the city of New York.

all_lanza_bills.title: Authorizes the commissioner of education to reschedule cancelled regents examinations
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires the commissioner of education to reschedule cancelled regents examinations within 20 business days of the original date.

all_lanza_bills.title: Requires a course of instruction on the provisions of the federalist papers and the United States constitution to be provided to high school students
all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires a course of instruction on the provisions of the federalist papers and the United States constitution to be provided to high school students.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to the common core state standards initiative; establishes the department shall discontinue implementation of the common core state standards.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires the education department to report the results of English/language arts and mathematics assessments to parents of pupils by the last day of classes.

all_lanza_bills.title: Provides for the issuance of temporary retail permits by the state liquor authority; repealer
all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for the issuance of temporary retail permits by the state liquor authority if certain conditions are met.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Provides for a personal income tax deduction for school supplies paid for out-of-pocket by K-12 teachers in public and nonpublic schools, up to $500 per year.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to penalties for intent to cause injury to an animal.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Directs the department of health to assign at least 1 narcotics investigator to each county in a city having a population of one million or more.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to sanctions for driving while ability impaired while holding a conditional license.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires pre-employment investigation of school district personnel to determine criminal history or the presence of controlled substances or communicable diseases; requires submission to fingerprinting and other tests.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires gas and electric corporations to charge not-for-profit organized sports programs for youth residential rates for utilities.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have surveillance cameras in the common areas of their residential facilities.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Relates to creating the multi-disciplinary team demonstration program for complex cases of adult abuse, neglect, or financial exploitation.

all_lanza_bills.summary: Creates the crimes of dangerous driving in the fifth, fourth, third, second and first degrees; imposes criminal liability on drivers who continue to operate motor vehicles in violation of the vehicle and traffic law and cause injury as a result.
